apps.name: Morphe Aiocal
apps.description: Aiocal (All-in-One Calculator) APK from the community AutoBuilds pipeline, built with hoo-dles' morphe-patches. One universal APK, no root.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Aiocal?

Aiocal is the app that goes by All-in-One Calculator on Android. Besides a normal calculator it has a long list of specialised calculators and unit converters sorted into categories, so algebra and unit conversion live in one app instead of five.

The APK here comes from the community AutoBuilds pipeline, which ran it through hoo-dles' morphe-patches. That's a third-party bundle, not the official Morphe patches, and there's a catch: its public patch list has nothing for Aiocal right now. We can't tell you what, if anything, was changed. Assume you're getting more or less the stock app with a new signature, and don't expect paid features to be switched on.

What to Expect

Calculators and converters

The full app is there: the basic calculator plus the categorised tools and unit converters.

No Aiocal-specific patch

hoo-dles' bundle has no patch for this app's package, so there's no ad removal or Pro unlock we can point to.

One APK for every phone

Only a Universal build is published. It carries native libraries for both 64-bit and 32-bit ARM, so there's nothing to choose.

Updates come from here

Google Play won't update a re-signed APK. The download box on this page always points to the newest build.

Installing Aiocal

  1. Grab the Universal APK from the download box. It's the only file, so there's no architecture to pick.
  2. Already have All-in-One Calculator from Google Play? Uninstall it first. This build is signed with a different key and Android won't put it on top of the Play Store copy.
  3. Open the downloaded file. If Android asks, let your browser or file manager install unknown apps, then tap Install.

Questions About Morphe Aiocal

It was built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline from hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches bundle. Neither the Aiocal developer, the Morphe team nor this site made it. Any modified APK carries some risk, so only install it if you're comfortable with that source.

We can't say. The bundle's published patch list has no entry for Aiocal, so the build may be little more than the original app with a new signature. If you need a paid feature, don't count on this APK having it.

No. Both use the same package name, and the bundle's rename patch is optional and off by default, so only one of them can be on your phone.

No, it installs like any other APK.

apps.name: Morphe Alarmo
apps.description: Alarmo alarm clock with its premium wake-up missions (push-ups, squats, Walk Off and more) opened up by Paresh Maheshwari's community patches.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Alarmo?

Alarmo (Alarmo – Smart Alarm Clock, made by Bytesong) is for people who sleep through normal alarms. You pick a mission when you set the alarm, and it keeps ringing until you finish it: a math problem, scanning a QR code you stuck in the bathroom, taking a photo that matches one you saved, and so on. The harder, more physical missions are the ones the free version keeps behind the premium upgrade.

This APK carries exactly one change, the “Unlock Premium” patch from Paresh Maheshwari’s community paresh-patches bundle. It isn’t an official Morphe patch. The community AutoBuilds pipeline applies it with Morphe CLI, and this site simply links to the finished file.

Missions the patch opens up

Push-Up, Squats and Jumping Jack

The exercise missions count your reps before the alarm will stop. Hard to stay half asleep after a set of squats.

Step and Walk Off

Walking missions that make you get out of bed and actually move around before you can silence the alarm.

Lights On

The Lights On mission is included too, so the alarm is tied to switching the room lights on.

Wake Up check

The optional follow-up check that makes sure you didn’t drift back to sleep after dismissing the alarm.

Free missions stay as they were

Math, QR or barcode, photo and the memory games aren’t touched by the patch. They work exactly like the Play Store app.

Installing it

  1. Before anything else, open the Play Store version of Alarmo and note down your alarms. You’ll have to uninstall it, and the alarms go with it.
  2. Uninstall the Play Store Alarmo. This build is signed with a different key, so Android won’t install it over the original.
  3. Download the APK from the box above. There’s only one file, a Universal build that runs on any ARM phone, 64-bit or older 32-bit.
  4. Open it and allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps when Android asks.
  5. Start Alarmo, give it the alarm, notification and (for photo or step missions) camera and activity permissions, then set your alarms up again.

Alarmo questions

It's the regular Alarmo app with one patch from Paresh Maheshwari's open-source paresh-patches bundle, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. Neither Bytesong nor the Morphe developers made it, and any modified APK carries some risk. Install it only if you trust that source.

According to the patch description: Lights On, Step and Walk Off, Push-Up, Squats, Jumping Jack, and the Wake Up check. The missions that were already free don't change.

No. Both use the same package name but different signatures, so you have to remove the Play Store version first. Your saved alarms won't carry over.

No. The Play Store won't update a re-signed APK. When a newer build shows up in the download box, download it and install it over this one.

apps.name: Morphe Avocards

apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Avocards?

Avocards is a flashcard app for learning Korean words. You work through decks of cards, mark the ones you knew, and go back over the ones you didn't.

A good part of it normally sits behind a subscription. This build was made by the community AutoBuilds pipeline using hoo-dles' morphe-patches (a third-party bundle, not official Morphe), and it applies one patch: Enable Premium, which switches on the features locked behind that paywall inside the app.

What the Patch Does

Enable Premium

The only Avocards patch in the bundle. It makes the app treat subscription-only features as available.

Same decks, same app

Nothing else is reworked. The cards, reviews and layout are what you'd get from Google Play.

Your account isn't touched

The unlock lives in the app. No subscription is created on your Avocards account, and it's gone if you switch back to the Play Store version.

Universal APK

One file for all phones, no architecture to work out.

How to Install Morphe Avocards

  1. If Avocards from Google Play is on your phone, uninstall it. The signatures differ, so the patched APK can't go on top.
  2. Download the Universal APK above and open it.
  3. Allow the install from unknown sources when prompted, tap Install, and open Avocards as usual.

Avocards FAQ

It comes from the community AutoBuilds pipeline, which builds it with hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches. It isn't official: not from the Avocards team, not from Morphe and not from this site. Modified apps always carry some risk, so install it only if you trust where it came from.

No. The patch flips the checks inside the app. Anything Avocards decides on its own servers may still behave like a free account, and an app update can break the patch until the bundle catches up.

No. Play only updates apps signed with the original key. New builds show up on this page instead.

apps.name: Morphe Bussu
apps.description: Busuu APK patched with hoo-dles' community Enable Premium patch and built by AutoBuilds. Universal APK, installs without root.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Bussu?

Bussu here means Busuu, the language-learning app with short lessons in a range of languages and a community of native speakers who correct each other's writing and speaking exercises.

Plenty of lessons and tools on Busuu are reserved for Premium. The APK on this page was built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with hoo-dles' morphe-patches, a third-party bundle rather than the official Morphe patches. For Busuu that bundle has exactly one patch, Enable Premium, which opens up what the app normally hides behind its subscription screen.

What's Different in This Build

Enable Premium

Removes the paywall check in the app, so Premium-locked lessons and tools open on a free account.

Community corrections unchanged

Feedback from native speakers runs through Busuu's servers like before. The patch doesn't touch that part.

Your normal login

You sign in with your existing Busuu account. Nothing gets purchased on it.

One universal file

There is only a Universal APK, so you don't need to know your phone's CPU type.

Getting It on Your Phone

  1. Make sure the progress you care about is tied to your Busuu account, then uninstall the Play Store Busuu. Android rejects the patched APK while the original, differently signed app is installed.
  2. Download the APK from the box at the top of the page.
  3. Open it, allow installs from your browser if asked, and finish with Install.
  4. Log in and pick up your course.

Common Questions

It's an unofficial build. The community AutoBuilds pipeline produced it from hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches, not Busuu or the Morphe developers, and this site only links to it. Installing a modified APK is always a risk, so do it only if you trust that source.

No. The unlock exists only inside this patched Android app. Your account is still a free one, so busuu.com and other devices show the free tier.

No. It installs as a regular app.

The Play Store won't update this build. When AutoBuilds publishes a newer one, the download box here points to it.

apps.name: Morphe Cake
apps.description: Cake APK built with hoo-dles' community Enable Plus patch. Plus is only partly unlocked and the patch is version-specific. No root.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Cake?

Cake teaches everyday English, with Korean courses as well, using short clips taken from shows and videos. You watch a line, say it back, and the app checks your pronunciation.

This APK was built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline using hoo-dles' morphe-patches, a third-party bundle and not the official Morphe set. Its one Cake patch is Enable Plus. The patch description itself warns that not every Plus feature becomes available, and it's flagged as tied to one exact Cake version. The patch list names an older Cake release than the one built here, so the unlock may not apply at all, or only partly work, on this build.

What You Get

Clip-based lessons

Cake itself is unchanged: short video expressions, listening and repeat-after-me practice.

Enable Plus (partial)

Turns on Cake Plus membership inside the app, though the bundle says some Plus features stay unavailable.

Version-sensitive

The patch is written for one specific Cake version. If the build above doesn't match it, expect Plus to be missing or flaky.

Single Universal APK

No ARM64 or ARMv7 choice to make; one file covers both.

Install Steps

  1. Uninstall Cake from Google Play if you have it. The patched build has a different signature and won't install over it.
  2. Tap the download button above.
  3. Open the APK from your notifications or Downloads folder and allow the install.
  4. Open Cake and check whether Plus actually shows as active before relying on it.

Morphe Cake FAQ

It's a modified app built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches. Cake's developer, the Morphe project and this site had no part in making it. Treat it like any modified APK: there's some risk, so install it only if you trust the source.

Two likely reasons. The patch only enables part of Plus by design, and it's marked as working on one exact Cake version, which may not be the version built here. If the patch didn't take, the app simply behaves like the free version.

No. The package name is the same, so Android sees one app with two mismatched signatures and refuses.

apps.name: Morphe Calistree
apps.description: Calistree APK from the community AutoBuilds pipeline, built with brosssh's morphe-patches. That bundle no longer has a Calistree patch.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Calistree?

Calistree is a calisthenics app built around skill trees. You pick a move you want to learn, say a muscle-up or a handstand, and it walks you through the easier progressions that lead up to it. Part of the program sits behind a Pro subscription.

This APK comes from the community AutoBuilds pipeline, which ran it through Morphe CLI with the third-party brosssh/morphe-patches bundle. That's not the official Morphe patch set, and you should know what it means here. The bundle used to have an Unlock Pro features patch for Calistree, but it was removed from the bundle earlier this year, and the release used for this build has nothing for Calistree at all. As far as we can tell, you're getting the regular app, re-signed. Don't expect Pro to be unlocked.

What you actually get

No Calistree patch in this bundle

We checked the patch file this build was made from. It has patches for Komoot, Mapy, park4night and a few other apps, but none for Calistree.

The app as you know it

Skill trees, progressions and the exercise library behave the same as in the Play Store version, since nothing in the code was targeted.

One APK for every phone

There's only a Universal build, so you don't need to work out your phone's CPU architecture.

You update it yourself

The Play Store won't touch a re-signed APK. We pull fresh links from the AutoBuilds release several times a day, so check back here for new versions.

How to Install Morphe Calistree

  1. If you already have Calistree from the Play Store, uninstall it first. This APK is signed with a different key and Android won't install it on top of the store version.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above.
  3. When Android asks, allow your browser or file manager to install apps (Settings → Apps → Special app access → Install unknown apps).
  4. Open the APK, tap Install, then sign back in to Calistree if you use an account.

Morphe Calistree FAQ

It's unofficial. The community AutoBuilds pipeline took the original Calistree APK, ran it through Morphe CLI with brosssh's open-source morphe-patches bundle, and re-signed it. Neither the Calistree developers nor the Morphe team built it. Any modified APK carries some risk, so only install it if you trust that pipeline.

We can't say it does. The brosssh release used for this build has no Calistree patch. An older Unlock Pro features patch existed but it's been removed from the bundle. Plan on the same free and Pro split as the store version.

Because the Play Store copy is signed by the Calistree developers and this one isn't. Uninstall the store version, then install the APK again.

apps.name: Morphe Camscanner

What is Morphe CamScanner?

CamScanner, from INTSIG, turns your phone camera into a document scanner. Point it at a page or a receipt, it finds the edges, cleans up the image and saves it as a PDF or picture, with text recognition on top.

The build here was made by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with hoo-dles' morphe-patches, a third-party bundle rather than official Morphe. Two CamScanner patches went in. One shuts off CamScanner's own telemetry system. The other enables some of the features normally behind the Premium subscription, though the patch notes say server-side functions may still be missing.

Patches in This Build

Disable telemetry

Switches off CamScanner's in-house telemetry system inside the app.

Enable Premium (partial)

Opens some Premium-only tools. Not all of them: features that run on CamScanner's servers may still refuse to work.

Scanning works as before

Edge detection, cropping and PDF export are part of the normal app and aren't touched by the patches.

Universal APK

One download that fits any phone, no CPU architecture to look up.

How to Install Morphe CamScanner

  1. Export or sync any scans you want to keep, then uninstall the Play Store CamScanner. Because the signatures differ, the patched copy won't install on top.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above.
  3. Open it and approve the unknown-apps prompt for your browser or file manager.
  4. Install, open CamScanner and grant camera access when it asks.

CamScanner Questions

It's unofficial. The community AutoBuilds pipeline built it using hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches; INTSIG, the Morphe team and this site didn't make it. Modified APKs always carry some risk, so only install it if you trust that pipeline.

apps.name: Morphe Chargeprice
apps.description: Chargeprice APK with brosssh's Unlock Premium features patch, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. Needs a Chargeprice account. No root.

What is Morphe Chargeprice?

Chargeprice is for EV drivers who are tired of guessing what a charge will cost. You pick a charging station and your car, and it compares prices across the charging cards and tariffs that work there, so you can see which one is cheapest before you plug in.

The APK here was built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with Morphe CLI and the third-party brosssh/morphe-patches bundle (not the official Morphe patches). That bundle has exactly one patch for Chargeprice, Unlock Premium features, and it's on by default, so it's in this build. Its description adds one condition: you have to be logged in with an account for it to work.

Morphe Chargeprice Features

Unlock Premium features

brosssh's only Chargeprice patch. It switches on the Premium side of the app without a subscription.

Sign in first

The patch only kicks in when you're logged in to a Chargeprice account. Signed out, you'll see the free app.

Price comparison unchanged

Station search and tariff comparison work the same. The patch only touches what Premium gates.

No Play Store updates

Re-signed apps don't update from the store. Grab new builds here; the links refresh several times a day.

How to Install Morphe Chargeprice

  1. Got Chargeprice from the Play Store? Uninstall it first, because the patched APK has a different signature and won't install over it.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above. There's only one build, so no need to pick an architecture.
  3. Allow installs from unknown sources for your browser if Android asks (Settings → Apps → Special app access → Install unknown apps).

Morphe Chargeprice FAQ

It's unofficial. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched the original APK with Morphe CLI and brosssh's open-source morphe-patches bundle and re-signed it. The Chargeprice team and the Morphe team didn't build it. Modified APKs carry risk, so only install it if you trust the source.

Usually because the Play Store version is still on the phone. Different signing keys can't share a package name, so remove the store copy and try again.

apps.name: Morphe Crex
apps.description: CREX - Just Cricket APK built with the CREX Premium patch from community paresh-patches: ads removed and premium features unlocked. No root.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe CREX?

CREX – Just Cricket (it used to be called Cricket Exchange) is where a lot of fans follow matches ball by ball: live scores, commentary, full scorecards, player stats and series tables for international and league cricket. The catch in the free app is the ads, which pop up exactly when you open a score in the middle of an over, and a few extras that need a CREX subscription.

The build linked here applies a single patch called CREX Premium from Paresh Maheshwari’s paresh-patches bundle. According to its description it removes ads and unlocks the premium features. That’s a community patch, not an official Morphe one; the AutoBuilds pipeline does the patching and this site only points you to the APK.

What changes in this build

Ads removed

The CREX Premium patch strips the ads, so checking a score is open app, read, close.

Premium features

Whatever CREX gates behind its premium plan inside the app is switched on. The patch doesn’t list the individual features.

Live data is untouched

Scores, commentary and stats still come from CREX’s own servers, the same feed the official app uses.

One Universal APK

A single file for every ARM phone. You don’t have to work out your CPU type.

The patch was written against an earlier CREX release. The AutoBuilds pipeline applies it to newer versions too, so if a premium screen still shows a paywall, that part of the patch probably no longer matches the current app.

How to install CREX from here

  1. If you have CREX from the Play Store, uninstall it first. The signatures differ and Android will refuse to install over it.
  2. Grab the Universal APK from the download box above.
  3. Tap the downloaded file and allow installs from your browser or file manager when prompted.
  4. Open CREX, pick your favourite teams again and turn notifications back on if you want wicket and score alerts.

CREX FAQ

It's the normal CREX app patched with Paresh Maheshwari's open-source paresh-patches bundle and built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It's unofficial, CREX has nothing to do with it, and modified APKs always carry some risk. Only install it if you trust the source.

Its description says it removes ads and unlocks premium features. It doesn't spell out which features, so we won't either. Anything CREX checks on its own servers may still be limited.

apps.name: Morphe Crunchyroll

What is Morphe Crunchyroll?

Crunchyroll is Sony's anime streaming service: new episodes as simulcasts shortly after they air in Japan, a big back catalogue, and subbed and dubbed versions of many shows.

Please read this before downloading. The APK is produced by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with hoo-dles' morphe-patches, a third-party bundle. hoo-dles used to ship an Enable Premium patch for Crunchyroll but removed it, and the current patch list has nothing for the app. As far as we can tell, this build is the regular Crunchyroll app with a different signature. It does not unlock Premium, and you shouldn't expect ads to be gone either.

What This Build Is (and Isn't)

Regular Crunchyroll

Browsing, the watchlist and playback work like the Play Store app, limited to what your account tier allows.

No Premium unlock

The Crunchyroll premium patch was deleted from hoo-dles' bundle and nothing replaced it.

Ads unchanged

Free accounts still get Crunchyroll's ads. Nothing in the current bundle removes them.

Universal APK

One file for all phones.

If You Still Want to Install It

  3. Download the Universal APK, open it and allow installs from unknown sources when asked.

Crunchyroll FAQ

It's an unofficial rebuild from the community AutoBuilds pipeline using hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches, not something Crunchyroll, the Morphe developers or this site produced. Any modified APK is a risk, so only install it if you trust that source.

Not through Google Play. Newer builds, as long as AutoBuilds keeps producing them, appear on this page.

apps.name: Morphe Dialer
apps.description: Google Phone (Dialer) APK with Taknok's patch that silences the call recording announcement. Built with ReVanced CLI. Unofficial, no root needed.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Dialer?

This is Google's own Phone app, the dialer on Pixel phones that Google also offers for some other Android phones. In regions where Google allows it, the app can record calls, but it plays a spoken notice to both people when a recording starts and again when it stops.

The patch in this build, Call recording announcements remover from Taknok's community bundle revanced-patches, replaces those two voice prompts with silence. It also adds a dot to the end of the search bar hint, so you can tell at a glance that you're running the patched copy. The community AutoBuilds pipeline built the APK with ReVanced CLI, not Morphe. Neither the Morphe developers nor this site made it.

What's different

No spoken recording notice

The starting and ending recording announcements are blanked out, so starting a recording no longer plays the voice prompt.

A dot in the search bar

The search hint ends with an extra ".". It's the patch's way of marking the modified app.

Everything else is stock

Calling, contacts, voicemail and call screening behave like the regular Google Phone app. Only the two prompts and the hint changed.

Recording still depends on region

The patch doesn't switch call recording on. If Google hasn't enabled it for your country or carrier, this build won't add it.

Recording laws differ a lot. In many places everyone on the call has to agree to be recorded, and removing the announcement doesn't change that. Check what applies where you live.

Installing the patched dialer

  1. Check whether Google Phone came preinstalled on your phone. On Pixels and other phones where it's a system app, Android won't accept a copy signed with a different key, so this APK won't install there without root.
  2. If you installed Google Phone yourself from the Play Store, uninstall it first.
  3. Download the universal APK from the box above and open it. Allow installs from your browser or file manager if asked.
  4. Go to Settings → Apps → Default apps → Phone app and pick Phone so it handles your calls.

Questions about the patched Phone app

It's Google's Phone app with one resource patch from Taknok's open-source revanced-patches bundle, built with ReVanced CLI by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It isn't from Google or the Morphe developers. A dialer handles your calls and contacts, so think twice. It is an unofficial, modified APK, and any modified APK carries some risk, so only install it if you trust the source.

No. It only silences the announcement. Whether the record button shows up at all is still decided by Google for your region and carrier.

Usually not. On Pixels the Phone app is part of the system image. Android keeps that copy even if you uninstall updates, and it refuses to install a version signed with a different key over it.

That depends on where you and the other person are. Many places require consent from everyone on the call. The patch doesn't change your legal obligations.

apps.name: Morphe Disney+
apps.description: Disney+ APK with a floating playback speed and aspect ratio panel from hashtagbasit's aimal-patches. A subscription is still required. Unofficial build.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Disney+?

Disney+ is Disney's streaming service, home to Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars and National Geographic. The app doesn't give you much control over playback. There's no speed setting, and on tall phone screens a widescreen film either leaves black bars or gets cropped the way the app decides.

This build adds one patch, Playback speed and aspect ratio, from hashtagbasit's community bundle aimal-patches. It puts a small floating panel on the player. The community AutoBuilds pipeline built it with Morphe CLI. It isn't an official Morphe patch, and it doesn't change anything about your subscription.

What you get

Playback speed control

Speed up a slow documentary or slow down a scene from the floating panel. The stock app has no speed option.

Stretch, crop or zoom

Fill a tall phone screen by zooming or stretching the picture instead of watching with black bars on both sides.

Your plan stays the same

You still sign in with your own Disney+ account. The patch doesn't remove ads on the ad-supported plan or unlock content.

The rest is stock

Profiles, downloads and the catalogue are the normal Disney+ app. The panel is the only addition.

How to install

  1. Uninstall the Play Store version of Disney+ first, since the two copies are signed differently. Downloaded episodes are removed with it.
  2. Get the universal APK from the download box. There's only one file.
  3. Open it, allow installs from your browser or file manager when asked, and install.
  4. Sign in with your Disney+ account and start something. The speed and aspect panel shows up on the player.

Disney+ FAQ

It's the official Disney+ app with one patch from hashtagbasit's open-source aimal-patches bundle, built with Morphe CLI by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It isn't from Disney or the Morphe developers. It is an unofficial, modified APK, and any modified APK carries some risk, so only install it if you trust the source.

No. You still need a paid subscription, and the ad-supported plan still has ads. The only change is the playback speed and aspect ratio panel.

Most phones are much taller than a 16:9 or 2.39:1 film. Zooming or stretching lets the picture fill more of the screen, which some people prefer to black bars.

The bundle lists HBO Max and Viki as supported too, but this page is only for the Disney+ build.

apps.name: Morphe Documentscanner
apps.description: Document Scanner - PDF Creator APK with ads removed, pro themes and premium tools unlocked by the Doc Scanner Premium community patch.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Document Scanner?

This is Document Scanner – PDF Creator from Lufick Technology, a phone scanner for receipts, forms, ID copies and anything else you’d otherwise feed through a flatbed. You point the camera at the page, it crops and cleans up the shot, and you save it as a PDF or JPEG, sort it into folders, print it or send it off to Drive or Dropbox. It also reads and creates QR codes.

The APK here is patched with “Doc Scanner Premium” from Paresh Maheshwari’s community paresh-patches bundle. That patch says it unlocks all premium features, removes ads and enables the pro themes. It’s a third-party patch rather than an official Morphe one, applied by the AutoBuilds pipeline.

What the patch gives you

No ads between scans

You can scan a stack of pages in a row without an ad popping up after each save.

Pro themes

The themes reserved for paying users are available from the start.

Premium tools

Features the app normally sells as premium are switched on. The patch doesn’t publish an exact list.

Same scanning engine

Cropping, the colour, B/W and lighten filters, and PDF export come straight from the original app.

QR codes too

The built-in QR and barcode scanner and generator are still there.

Eggbun teaches Korean through chat. Lessons play out as a conversation with a cartoon teacher, and you answer by tapping or typing replies while you pick up Hangul, grammar and everyday phrases.

Universal APK

One file works on every phone.

Eyecon Caller ID & Spam Block shows who’s calling with a full-screen name and photo, flags spam calls and texts, and replaces your contacts list with a big photo grid. It also has its own dialer and a reverse lookup for unknown numbers. A few things in the app are sold as Eyecon Premium.

What you can expect

Premium switched on

The in-app premium status is unlocked. Exactly what that covers depends on what Eyecon currently puts behind its paywall.

Full-screen caller ID

Incoming calls show a name and photo across the whole screen, same as the regular app.

Spam call and SMS blocking

Spam detection and blocking come from the original app and its lookup service.

Photo contacts and dialer

The visual contact grid and Eyecon’s dialer work as usual if you choose to use them.

Installing Eyecon

What is Morphe Fing?

Fing – Network Tools from Fing Limited is the app you open when you want to know what’s on your Wi-Fi. It lists every device on the network and tries to identify it, runs internet speed tests, and has ping, traceroute and port scans for when something isn’t working. The APK here is patched with “Fing Premium” from Paresh Maheshwari’s community paresh-patches bundle, which says it unlocks premium network tools and features. It’s not an official Morphe patch. The community AutoBuilds pipeline builds it and this site links to the result.

What’s in this build

Premium network tools

The paid tools inside the app are unlocked, according to the patch. Which ones exactly isn’t documented.

Device discovery

The regular network scan and device identification work as they do in the official app, no root needed.

Speed tests

Fing’s internet speed test is part of the base app and unchanged.

Troubleshooting basics

Ping, traceroute and port scanning are still where you’d expect them.

Anything that runs on Fing’s servers or depends on Fing hardware, such as account-wide monitoring or a Fingbox, can’t be unlocked by patching the phone app.

  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above and tap it to install. Allow installs from unknown apps for your browser or file manager if asked.

Fing FAQ

It's the Fing app with Paresh Maheshwari's open-source Fing Premium patch, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It's unofficial and not from Fing Limited. Modified APKs always carry some risk, and a network scanner sees a lot about your network, so install it only if you trust the source.

Web Access

Browse and move files on your phone from a web browser on your computer over the same Wi-Fi.

apps.name: Morphe Gamehub

What is Morphe GameHub?

GameHub is GameSir's "portable console" app. It mixes cloud gaming, trending game lists, a retro library you fill with your own files, and controller tools in one place. A lot of people also use it to run PC games on their phone.

The trouble starts when you use a front-end like ES-DE or Daijisho to organise everything. Stock GameHub doesn't let other apps open a specific game. The Front-end Export patch from liaralabs' community bundle revanced-patches fixes that. The community AutoBuilds pipeline built this APK with ReVanced CLI, not Morphe. The Morphe developers and this site have nothing to do with the build.

What the patch does

Game screen opened to other apps

The patch exports GameHub's game detail screen, so a front-end can open a game directly instead of dropping you on GameHub's home screen.

A launch intent to target

It adds the com.gamehub.LAUNCH_GAME action. Point your front-end's launch command at it.

Crash fix for external launches

It also patches the game screen so an external launch doesn't crash it with a number format error.

Nothing else changed

Cloud gaming, the retro library and controller settings are the stock app. The bundle's debugging and email login patches are off by default.

Setting it up

  1. Uninstall the GameHub you have now if it came from the Play Store or GameSir's site. Signatures differ, so Android won't update over it. Back up any saves or containers you care about first.
  2. Download the universal APK from the box above and install it. Allow installs from unknown apps if Android asks.
  3. Open GameHub, sign in if you use an account, and add your games as usual.

GameHub questions

It's GameHub with one patch from liaralabs' open-source revanced-patches bundle, built with ReVanced CLI by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It isn't from GameSir or the Morphe developers. apps.name: Morphe Gboard
apps.description: Gboard APK with jasonwu1994's community patches: bigger clipboard, custom themes, OCR scanning and a cursor trackpad. Installs next to the regular Gboard.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Gboard?

Gboard is Google's Android keyboard. A surprising amount of it is hidden behind server flags or rolled out slowly country by country. This build uses jasonwu1994/Gboard-patches, a community bundle for the Morphe patcher, to switch a lot of that on and add tools Gboard never had. It doesn't come from the Morphe developers, and the APK itself is built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline.

The author writes in Traditional Chinese and English, and a handful of patches only matter if you type Zhuyin (slide input, a quick Traditional/Simplified toggle). The rest is useful to anyone. The clipboard keeps more for longer, you can import ZIP themes or pull them from the Rboard repository, there's OCR text scanning and a calculator in the suggestion row, and a flag editor if you like poking around.

What jasonwu1994's patches add to Gboard

A clipboard that keeps more

Raise how long clips are kept, how many are stored and how many characters each one holds. Preview lines, timestamps and column count can be changed too.

Web Clipboard

The phone runs a small web clipboard you can pair with a browser on your computer, with a Quick Settings tile to turn it on and off.

Themes and key shapes

Import custom ZIP themes or ones from the Rboard repository, switch to rounded keys, round the panel corners and put the G logo on the spacebar.

Trackpad and editing shortcuts

Long-press the space bar for a cursor trackpad. Long-press shortcuts for select all, undo, copy, cut, paste and redo are added to QWERTY and Zhuyin.

Scan text with OCR

Turns on Gboard's Scan Text feature with Latin, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Devanagari recognition.

Calculator and floating search

Type a sum and the answer appears in the suggestion row. A floating web page lets you look something up without leaving the app you're in.

Writing tools turned on

Enables AI writing tools for all languages, grammar check, Smart Compose and advanced voice typing with automatic punctuation. They still depend on Google's backend, so results vary by language.

Developer options and backup

A flag editor, backup and restore for your patch settings, an incognito toggle in the toolbar, and even a LAN FTP server, which is an odd thing for a keyboard to have.

Getting Morphe Gboard running

  1. Download the APK from the box above. It's labelled Universal, but Gboard's own version name ends in arm64-v8a, which suggests Google's ARM64 build. Expect it to work on 64-bit ARM phones, which is nearly all of them.
  2. Install it, allowing unknown apps for your browser or file manager when asked. You can keep the Play Store Gboard. The Package Rename patch gives this one its own package name, so both can be installed.
  3. Go to your phone's keyboard settings (usually Settings → System → Keyboard, depending on the phone), enable the patched Gboard and set it as the default. Android shows a warning that keyboards can see what you type. That's standard for every keyboard.
  4. Open the patched Gboard's settings to set up themes, the clipboard and the other extras.

Morphe Gboard questions

This build is Google's Gboard with jasonwu1994's open-source Gboard-patches applied, put together by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It's not an official Morphe bundle. A keyboard sees everything you type, passwords included, so trust matters more here than with most apps. Read the patch repository and only install it if you're comfortable.

Premium stays Premium

Universal build only

Universal APK

One download, no architecture choice.

It's unofficial, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline from hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches; not by Google, the Morphe team or this site. A modified Google app always carries some risk, so install it only if you trust that source.

apps.description: Google Photos APK with Akash-Sriram's community Morphe patches: Pixel feature spoofing, per-folder backup control and an AMOLED theme. Needs MicroG RE.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Google Photos?

Google Photos is the gallery and cloud backup app that comes with most Android phones. This build applies Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos, a small community bundle written for the Morphe patcher. It isn't part of the official Morphe patches, and the APK is produced by the community AutoBuilds pipeline, not by Morphe or by this site.

The patch people come for is Spoof features, which makes Photos believe it's running on a Google Pixel so Pixel-only features appear. The patch author says that includes unlimited storage. That's Google's call on its servers, though, so treat it as something that may work today and stop working later. The other patches are quieter: per-folder backup control, a true black dark mode, a flag manager, and a fix for AI tools that refuse to download on mobile data.

What this Google Photos build changes

Pixel feature spoofing

Reports the device as a Google Pixel so Pixel-exclusive features show up. Backup storage limits are still enforced by Google's servers.

Backup folder control

The Camera and DCIM folders no longer back up no matter what. You choose folders one by one, and memory collages and creations get exported to DCIM/Google Photos.

AMOLED dark theme

Dark surfaces turn true black, which looks better on OLED screens. Light mode is left alone.

Flag manager and toolkit

Adds a flag manager to Photos settings for trying experimental redesigns, video editor tools and other feature flags.

AI model and font fixes

Gets past the 0 MB mobile data check that stops AI models from downloading, and fixes fonts that load blank in Stories and parts of the UI.

Sign-in without root

The GmsCore support patch renames the package and routes Google sign-in through microG, so it works on an unrooted phone.

Setting up Morphe Google Photos

  1. Install MicroG RE first. You need it to sign in with your Google account, because the patched app uses microG instead of Google Play Services. Setup and common sign-in errors are in the MicroG RE guide.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above and install it, allowing your browser or file manager to install unknown apps if Android asks.
  3. You don't have to remove the preinstalled Google Photos. The patched app uses its own package name, so it shows up as a second Photos app.
  4. Open it, sign in through MicroG, give it access to your photos and set up backup the way you want.

If you keep both apps, turn backup off in one of them, or they'll both upload the same pictures.

Google Photos patch FAQ

It's Google's Photos APK with Akash-Sriram's open-source community patches applied, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It is not an official Morphe bundle and this site doesn't build it. Photos has access to your whole library, so think twice and only install it if you trust the source.

The Spoof features patch makes Photos treat your phone like a Pixel, and the patch author lists unlimited storage as one of the effects. Storage is decided on Google's servers, though, and Google can change or close that at any time. Don't count on it for anything you can't afford to lose.

The patched app is re-signed and renamed, so it can't use Google Play Services to log in. The GmsCore support patch makes it use microG instead. Without MicroG RE you can't sign in.

Yes. The patched build has a different package name, so both can be installed. Just don't let both of them back up the same folders.

Yes. Your backed-up library lives in your Google account, so once you sign in it loads the same way it would on a new phone.

What is Morphe HelloChinese?

HelloChinese is a Mandarin course aimed at beginners. Lessons are short and game-like: you practise tones by speaking, characters by tracing them, and listening with native-speaker audio.

A lot of the course sits behind HelloChinese Premium. The APK here was built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline using hoo-dles' morphe-patches, a third-party bundle that isn't official Morphe, and it applies the bundle's Enable Premium patch. One thing to know: that patch lists arm64-v8a as a requirement. The file is labelled Universal, but on an older 32-bit phone the unlock may not work.

Patch Details

Enable Premium

Opens the lessons and features HelloChinese locks behind its subscription.

Needs an ARM64 phone

The patch requires arm64-v8a. Nearly every recent phone qualifies; very old or low-end 32-bit devices may not.

Speaking and writing practice

Pronunciation checks and character tracing are regular app features, left as they are.

Universal download

There's only one APK, so you won't be asked to pick.

How to Install Morphe HelloChinese

HelloChinese FAQ

This is a modified build from the community AutoBuilds pipeline, made with hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches. It's not from HelloChinese, Morphe or this site. Modified APKs always involve some risk; install it only if you trust that source.

What is Morphe Hevy?

Hevy is a gym log. You build routines, then tick off sets, reps and weights as you train, and it keeps your history and personal records. There's also a social feed where you can follow friends' workouts. The free tier has caps that Hevy Pro removes.

What this build does and doesn't do

Logging works as usual

Routines, set tracking and your workout history are untouched. Nothing in the bundle targets Hevy.

No Hevy Pro

Without an app-specific patch, the free-tier limits are still there. Pro features need a real subscription.

Your data is in your account

Universal APK

Morphe Hevy FAQ

It's an unofficial build. The community AutoBuilds pipeline re-signed the original Hevy APK after running it through Morphe CLI with brosssh's open-source morphe-patches bundle. apps.name: Morphe ibisPaint

What is Morphe ibisPaint?

ibisPaint X, from the Japanese company ibis, is a drawing and painting app that a lot of digital and manga artists use on their phones. It has layers, a big brush library, rulers, screentones for manga and speed-paint recording. The free version shows ads, and a Prime membership unlocks a set of extra tools and materials.

The APK on this page was built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with Morphe CLI and hoo-dles/morphe-patches, a third-party bundle and not the official Morphe patches. The bundle has one ibisPaint patch, Enable Prime membership, on by default. Its description says it enables features locked behind the subscription paywall, and that it only works on arm64-v8a devices. The AutoBuilds maintainers later marked this patch as failing and stopped rebuilding ibisPaint, so this APK may fall behind the Play Store version.

About the Prime patch

Prime features in the app

Enable Prime membership turns on the parts of ibisPaint that the app itself locks behind Prime.

ARM64 only

The patch notes say it needs an arm64-v8a device. Most phones from the last several years qualify, but older 32-bit ones won't work.

Online features still check

Anything ibis serves from its servers for members may still ask for a real subscription.

Same drawing app

Canvases, brushes and layers are ibisPaint's own. Nothing about the drawing engine is changed.

Installing ibisPaint X

  1. Save your artwork first. Export or back up anything you care about, because the Play Store ibisPaint has to be uninstalled before this APK will install, and that deletes the app's local gallery.

  3. Allow your browser to install unknown apps and install the file.
  4. Open ibisPaint and import your backed-up work.

ibisPaint X FAQ

It's an unofficial build. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched the original ibisPaint X APK with Morphe CLI and hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches bundle and re-signed it. ibis and the Morphe team didn't make it. Modified APKs carry risk, so install it only if you trust the source.

You can. Uninstalling the Play Store version removes its local gallery, so back up or export your artwork before you install this build.

apps.name: Morphe Icon Pack Studio

What is Morphe Icon Pack Studio?

Icon Pack Studio comes from the same team as Smart Launcher. Instead of scrolling through icon packs until one almost matches your wallpaper, you build your own: pick a base shape, adjust colors, shadows and textures, then export the result as a pack your launcher can apply. The more advanced editing tools sit behind a Pro upgrade.

This APK has exactly one change. The Unlock pro patch from RookieEnough's community bundle De-Vanced makes the app treat you as a Pro user. It was applied with Morphe CLI by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. These are not the official Morphe patches, and the build doesn't come from the Morphe developers or from this site, which only links to it.

What this build changes

Pro tools available

The Unlock pro patch flips the app's Pro check, so the editor options that normally ask for the upgrade open straight away.

The editor itself is untouched

Shapes, colors, layers and export work the same way they do in the Play Store version. Nothing else was patched.

One universal APK

There is a single universal file, so there's no architecture to choose. It installs on any phone the app supports.

No purchase tied to your account

Pro is unlocked locally. Nothing is restored from or registered to your Google account.

Installing it

  1. If you already have Icon Pack Studio from the Play Store, export any packs you care about, then uninstall it. The two copies are signed with different keys, so Android won't install this one on top.
  2. Download the APK from the box above.
  3. Allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps when Android asks, then tap Install.
  4. Open the app, build a pack, and apply it from your launcher's icon pack setting.

Icon Pack Studio questions

It is the regular Icon Pack Studio app with one patch, Unlock pro, from RookieEnough's open-source De-Vanced bundle, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It isn't made by the Smart Launcher team or the Morphe developers. It is an unofficial, modified APK, and any modified APK carries some risk, so only install it if you trust the source.

What is Morphe Icon Packer?

Icon Packer lets you restyle the icons of the apps you have installed, adjusting things like shape, background and colour, and turn the result into your own icon pack for your launcher.

apps.name: Morphe Instagram
apps.description: Instagram APK patched with Piko by crimera: ads off, post and Reels downloads, feed and story filters, Focus Lock. ARM64 only, unofficial community build.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Instagram?

Instagram is Meta's app for photos, Reels, stories and DMs. This build applies Piko, crimera's community patch bundle, which started out patching Twitter and now covers Instagram too. Piko is written for the Morphe patcher but it is not one of the official Morphe bundles, and the APK comes from the community AutoBuilds pipeline, not from this site.

The default selection removes ads and lets you download posts, Reels, stories and highlights. It also gives you a lot of ways to make the app less sticky: hide Explore or the stories tray, keep the home feed to accounts you follow, or switch off endless Reels scrolling. Piko puts all of this in its own settings screen inside Instagram. Some of Piko's more invasive patches, such as anonymous story viewing and the Plus-benefit unlock, are not in the default set, so don't expect them in this APK.

What Piko changes in Instagram

Ads removed

Sponsored posts are gone. Suggested stories, Reels and Threads posts can be hidden too, though suggested posts in the feed still appear.

Download posts, Reels and stories

Save posts, Reels, stories and highlights, voice messages included, or send links to an external downloader. Images are fetched at full resolution.

A feed you control

Limit the home feed to profiles you follow, filter the stories you see, hide the stories tray or Explore, and stop the suggested-people cards.

Focus Lock

Pick what to block, such as Reels or Explore, and for how long. Once locked you can't switch it off early without a 24-hour wait. Reels people send you still open.

Quieter DMs

Lock the inbox behind your fingerprint or screen lock, hide your typing status, mark chats read only when you choose, and keep a local copy of messages the sender later deletes.

Who follows you back

A follows-you-back label on profiles, extra profile options like copying a handle or saving the profile picture, and a way to see the mentions in a story.

Look and layout

Material You or AMOLED theming, a custom font, a reorderable bottom bar, and adjustable story ring size and timestamps.

Cleaner links

Share links without tracking parameters or with a custom domain, open links in your own browser, and copy comment text.

Installing Morphe Instagram

  1. Check your phone first. This APK is ARM64 only. It won't install on 32-bit ARM phones or x86 devices, and there's no Universal file to fall back on.
  2. Uninstall the Play Store Instagram. Piko's Clone patch isn't part of this build, so it uses Instagram's normal package name, and Android won't install it over Meta's signed app.
  3. Download the APK from the box above, allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps, and install it.
  4. Log in, then open the Piko settings inside the app to turn features on or off.

Questions about Morphe Instagram

It's Instagram's own APK with crimera's open-source Piko patches applied, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It is not an official Morphe bundle. Meta's terms don't allow modified clients. We can't say how often that leads to action against accounts, but the risk isn't zero, so think about it before logging in with an account you care about.

apps.name: Morphe KakaoTalk

apps.description_html:
What is Morphe KakaoTalk?

KakaoTalk is Kakao's messenger and the default chat app for most people in Korea. Over the years it has filled up with extra layers: BizBoard ads in the friends list and chat list, a shopping tab, short-form video, and an unread badge that stops counting at 99 or 300+.

This build uses AmpleRevanced's community bundle revanced-patches and was built with Morphe CLI by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It's a large set, with dozens of KakaoTalk patches switched on by default, plus a settings tab where you can change many of them. These aren't official Morphe patches, and the Morphe developers didn't make this APK.

Highlights

Ads cleared out

Removes BizBoard ads in the friends and chat lists, More tab ads, OpenChat feed ads, the KakaoPay banner and short-form ads. The Shop and Short-form tabs go too.

Deleted messages stay visible

Deleted, hidden and edited messages remain readable in the chat log. Replies and reactions on them are blocked, so you don't respond to something the other side thinks is gone.

See who has read

Read receipts show which members have and haven't read each message, and unread counts show the real number instead of 99 or 300+.

Ghost mode

The other person doesn't see that you're typing.

Photo location stripped

Images sent in original quality lose their EXIF data, including GPS location. The picture and its orientation are kept.

Its own settings tab

A Morphe-style settings tab holds the added options, such as hiding More tab items, swiping to reply to feed messages and turning off OpenChat comments.

There's more in the set: forwarding links that are normally blocked, saving other people's profile photos, bigger text messages, and turning off Sentry and other trackers. The emoticon tweak lets you send an emoticon you haven't bought once a day, not freely.

Before and during install

  1. Back up your chats in KakaoTalk first (Settings → Chats → Back up chats). Uninstalling the official app deletes local chat history.
  2. Uninstall the Play Store KakaoTalk. Its signature differs from this build, so Android won't install over it.
  3. Download the universal APK from the box above, allow installs from unknown apps, and install it.
  4. Log in, restore your chat backup, and look through the added settings tab.

KakaoTalk FAQ

apps.name: Morphe Letterboxd

What is Morphe Letterboxd?

Letterboxd Mods screen

Letterboxd FAQ

Unlock premium features

Cloud stays limited

ARM64 only

Because the patch is version-strict, don't update Lightroom from the Play Store. Wait for a new build here.

MacroDroid from ArloSoft is a no-code automation app. You build macros out of a trigger (arriving home, plugging in the charger, a notification from some app), one or more actions, and optional constraints, and it runs them in the background. No macro cap

Pro features

Same triggers and actions

The full trigger, action and constraint library comes from the original app.

Import your old macros

MacroFactor is a calorie and macro tracker that doesn't just hand you a fixed target. One patch: Enable Premium (ROOT)

Mounted over the real app

The Play Store install stays on your phone and the patched code is mounted over it at boot.

Root is not optional

You manage updates

Unlock premium features

What is Morphe Messenger?

Messenger is Meta's chat app for your Facebook contacts. This build uses HushMessenger by SysAdminDoc, a community patch bundle for the Morphe patcher built around privacy and less clutter. It isn't an official Morphe bundle, and the APK is built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline rather than by Morphe or this site.

What HushMessenger can do

Read receipts and typing, your call

Open a chat without sending Seen, and stop showing others that you're typing, encrypted chats included. A Mark as read button lets you send Seen when you're ready.

Meta AI out of the way

Hides the Meta AI button, tab, menu entries and AI suggestions in search, plus the AI sticker tools.

Keep unsent messages

Fewer reports sent to Meta

Stops analytics uploads, ad attribution, app list and device ID sharing, nearby Wi-Fi scans and MQTT logging. These cut specific reports; they don't make Messenger private.

A cleaner inbox

Hide the stories and notes row, People You May Know, Facebook shortcuts, promotions and the People or Notifications tabs. You can pin up to 20 chats instead of 3.

Full-quality photos and video

With HD on, photos go out at full size and videos skip re-encoding, within Messenger's size limits. It also fixes videos that fail with Unable to send.

Stories without the pressure

View stories without appearing in the viewer list, save someone's story photo or video, and stop stories from moving on by themselves.

Look and feel

A Material You dark theme, system emoji, your own font, the old emoji drawer, chat heads or native bubbles, and any app icon without a subscription.

Installing Morphe Messenger

  1. Uninstall the Play Store Messenger. HushMessenger's clone patch isn't in this build, so it uses Messenger's own package name and can't install over Meta's signed app.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above and install it, allowing unknown apps for your browser or file manager if asked. The Install beside Meta apps patch is included, so it won't clash with the Facebook app if you have that installed.

apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Mladinska?

Mladinska knjiga is one of Slovenia's biggest publishers, and Mladinska knjiga PLUS is its digital library app. It has e-books, audiobooks and short book summaries (Branka), all in Slovene, from Slovene and translated authors. The full catalogue needs a PLUS subscription.

This APK carries one patch, Unlock Plus, from blazskufca's community repository revanced-patch. It makes the app report the "plus" permission for your user account. The community AutoBuilds pipeline built it with ReVanced CLI, so the Morphe patcher wasn't involved, and neither were the Morphe developers or this site.

About this build

Plus permission patched

The patch changes what the app reads as your account's permissions, so screens that check for PLUS should open.

Server checks are a different story

Books and audio are delivered from Mladinska knjiga's servers. If the server checks your real subscription, the patch can't get around that.

Same library, same app

Browsing, the reader and the audiobook player are the stock app. Unlock Plus is the only change.

Slovene only

Like the original, the app and its content are in Slovene.

How to install

  1. If you have the Play Store version, uninstall it first. The signatures don't match, so Android won't install over it.
  2. Download the universal APK from the box above.
  3. Open it and confirm the install, allowing unknown apps for your browser or file manager if asked.
  4. Sign in. The patch works on the logged-in user, so you'll most likely still need an account.

Mladinska knjiga PLUS FAQ

It's the publisher's app with a single patch from blazskufca's open-source revanced-patch repository, built with ReVanced CLI by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. apps.name: Morphe My Expenses
apps.description: My Expenses, the open-source finance app by Michael Totschnig, with hoo-dles' Enable Pro patch. Back up your data before you switch.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe My Expenses?

My Expenses is an open-source money tracker by Michael Totschnig that's been around for years. You set up your accounts, log what comes in and goes out, and it handles budgets, split transactions and recurring entries. Everything lives on your phone unless you set up sync. Some features need a paid licence, which is how the project pays for itself.

The APK here was patched by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with hoo-dles/morphe-patches, a third-party bundle by hoo-dles and not official Morphe. There's one patch for this app, Enable Pro, which turns on the licence-gated features. Since the app is open source and maintained by one developer, buying a licence is the decent thing to do if you end up relying on it.

My Expenses, patched

Enable Pro

The single My Expenses patch in the bundle. It switches on the features you'd normally buy a licence for.

Accounts and budgets

Track cash, bank and card accounts side by side, with budgets per category.

Splits and recurring entries

Split one receipt across categories, and set up rent or salary to repeat on its own.

Your data stays local

No account is required. The database sits on your phone until you choose to sync or back it up.

Switching to the patched build

  1. Back up first. Open your current My Expenses and make a backup, because uninstalling the app deletes its database.
  2. Uninstall the Play Store or F-Droid version. A differently signed APK can't replace it.
  3. Download the APK from the box above and allow installs from unknown sources.

Before you switch

It's built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline from hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches, not by the Morphe team or by this site, which only links to it. It's a finance app holding your records, so be extra careful and only install it if you trust these sources.

Only if you uninstall without a backup. My Expenses stores everything on the device, so make a backup in the old app first and restore it in the patched one.

No, it's a normal APK install.

apps.name: Morphe MyFitnessPal
apps.description: MyFitnessPal with hoo-dles' Enable Premium+ patch from the community morphe-patches bundle. Premium+ in the app only; your account isn't upgraded.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe MyFitnessPal?

MyFitnessPal is the calorie counter most people have tried at some point. You search its food database or scan a barcode, add it to breakfast, lunch or dinner, and it adds up calories, protein, carbs and fat against your goal. You need an account, and the extra features are split across Premium and Premium+ subscriptions.

This APK was patched by the community AutoBuilds pipeline using hoo-dles' morphe-patches, a third-party bundle rather than the official Morphe one. Its only MyFitnessPal patch is Enable Premium+, which lifts the paywall inside the app. Your account isn't upgraded, and anything MyFitnessPal works out on its own servers for paying members may still be off limits. Which parts work hasn't been tested here.

What changes in this build

Enable Premium+

The one patch for MyFitnessPal in the bundle. It targets the Premium+ features locked in the app.

Barcode logging

Scan a packet and the entry lands in your diary, as in the regular app.

Macro breakdowns

See how a day's calories split between protein, carbs and fat.

Same diary, same login

You sign in with your normal account, so your food log and weight history come with you.

Installing patched MyFitnessPal

  1. Download the APK from the box above. It's a single universal build.
  2. Uninstall the Play Store version. The patched one has a different signature and won't install over it. Your diary is saved to your account, so you won't lose it.

MyFitnessPal FAQ

It comes from the community AutoBuilds pipeline using hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches, not from the Morphe team or from this site, which only links to it. You'll be signing in with a real account, so only install it if you trust these sources.

apps.name: Morphe Niagara
apps.description: Niagara Launcher APK with d0nj's community patches: Pro unlocked, analytics removed and the giant numbers tile bug fixed. Unofficial build.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Niagara?

Niagara Launcher swaps the usual grid of icons for a single vertical list you can reach with one thumb. Notifications show up inline next to the app, and an alphabet strip on the edge gets you to anything else. Many of its features are Pro-only after a 7-day trial.

This build applies three patches from d0nj's community bundle morphe-patches, using Morphe CLI, through the community AutoBuilds pipeline: Pro unlocked, analytics removed, and a fix for a strange tile full of numbers on the home feed. The name is a little misleading. d0nj isn't one of the Morphe developers, and this isn't the official Morphe patch set.

The three patches

Unlock Pro

Niagara always sees a Pro entitlement, so Pro features work and the 7-day trial prompt never appears.

Remove analytics

Turns off the weekly usage report (app launches, notification metadata, survey answers), Singular attribution with your advertising ID, and Firebase Analytics.

Numbers tile fix

Sometimes a tile with hundreds of digits appears on the home feed after installing or removing apps, especially via ADB. That's a diagnostic tip from the Channels feature, and the patch stops it from showing.

Account sync isn't included

Things that depend on Niagara's servers, like account sync and paying through Stripe, aren't affected by the Pro patch.

Switching to this build

  1. If you already use Niagara from the Play Store, uninstall it. The signatures differ, so it can't be updated in place. Your home screen setup goes with it.
  2. Download the universal APK from the box above and install it. Allow unknown apps for your browser or file manager if Android asks.
  3. Press the home button and pick Niagara, or set it under Settings → Apps → Default apps → Home app.
  4. Add your favourite apps to the list again.

Niagara Launcher questions

It's Niagara Launcher with three patches from d0nj's open-source morphe-patches bundle, built with Morphe CLI by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. Despite the repo name, it isn't from the Morphe developers, and it isn't from Niagara's developer either. A launcher can see your notifications, so keep that in mind. It is an unofficial, modified APK, and any modified APK carries some risk, so only install it if you trust the source.

No. The patch unlocks Pro features on the device. Account sync goes through Niagara's servers, which still see a free account.

Niagara's Channels feature can post a diagnostic tip whose text is a long string of numbers. It appears as a tile on the home feed whenever the channel list refreshes. The patch makes Niagara decline those tip requests, so the tile never shows up.

apps.name: Morphe Nomone
apps.description: NOMone Desktop (Linux and VR) patched with hoo-dles' community morphe-patches: the 6-hour trial limit is removed and telemetry is off. No root.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Nomone?

NOMone Desktop, from NOMone Software, puts a Linux desktop on your Android phone, tablet or TV. You get windows you can move around and resize, a taskbar, and real Linux apps, all running on the device. If the phone screen is too small, there's a VR mode that floats the desktop in front of you in a headset. The free version stops you after a 6-hour trial.

This APK was patched by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with hoo-dles' morphe-patches, a third-party bundle and not the official Morphe one. The bundle has two patches for NOMone Desktop and both are on by default. Remove trial limit drops the 6-hour usage cap, and Disable telemetry stops the app sending event logs to NOMone's own endpoint.

Two patches, both applied

Remove trial limit

The 6-hour trial cap is gone, so a long session won't get cut off.

Disable telemetry

Event logging that the app normally sends to its own analytics endpoint is switched off.

A real desktop

Overlapping windows, a taskbar and Linux apps, running on the phone itself.

VR mode

Use the desktop in a headset when the phone screen is too cramped to work on.

Installing NOMone Desktop

  1. Download the APK from the box above. There's one universal file.
  2. If you installed NOMone Desktop from the Play Store, uninstall it first. The signatures differ, so Android won't install over it, and you'll lose whatever is inside the old install.
  3. Allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps, then install the APK.
  4. Open it and let it set up the Linux environment the way it normally would.

NOMone Desktop FAQ

Neither. The community AutoBuilds pipeline built it from hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches bundle, and this unofficial site links to it. Modified APKs carry risk, so install it only if you trust those sources.

apps.name: Morphe Nova Launcher
apps.description: Nova Launcher APK with Prime unlocked by the community Dropped-Patches bundle, built with ReVanced CLI. No Prime key needed. Unofficial build.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Nova Launcher?

Nova Launcher has been the go-to customisable home screen on Android for years. It was made by TeslaCoil Software and has belonged to Branch since 2022. The free version already handles icon packs, grid sizes and dock layouts. Things like gestures and hiding apps from the drawer need Nova Prime, sold as a separate key app.

This build applies the Unlock prime patch from indrastorms' community bundle Dropped-Patches. The bundle collects patches that other projects dropped. The community AutoBuilds pipeline built it with ReVanced CLI, not Morphe. Neither the Morphe developers nor this site had any part in it.

What changes

Prime without the key app

The patch sets Nova's Prime status directly, so Prime-only settings are available without installing Nova Launcher Prime.

Survives a restart

It uses the specific status value Nova expects, so your Prime preferences don't reset the next time the launcher restarts.

Gestures and drawer options

Swipe and pinch gestures, hidden apps and the other Prime extras open up alongside the free settings.

Otherwise plain Nova

Icon packs, layouts and backups work like the regular app. Only the Prime check was changed.

How to install

  1. In your current Nova, open Nova Settings → Backup & import settings and make a backup. Save it somewhere outside the app.
  2. Uninstall Nova from the Play Store. This build has a different signature and can't replace it in place.
  3. Download the universal APK from the box above, install it, and set Nova as your home app when Android asks.
  4. Restore the backup from step 1 so your home screen comes back.

Nova Launcher FAQ

It's Nova Launcher with one patch from indrastorms' open-source Dropped-Patches bundle, built with ReVanced CLI by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It isn't from Branch, TeslaCoil or the Morphe developers. It is an unofficial, modified APK, and any modified APK carries some risk, so only install it if you trust the source.

No. The Unlock prime patch turns Prime on inside the launcher itself, so you don't need the key app.

Only if you back it up first. Uninstalling the Play Store version wipes its settings. Make a backup in Nova Settings, then restore it after installing this build.

apps.name: Morphe Number
apps.description: Material Capsule APK (island-style shortcuts, media controls and notifications) built with Morphe CLI and community patches. Unofficial build, no root.

What is Morphe Number?

Despite the short name on this page, the app inside is Material Capsule: Island-Style by Vladimir Pryshedko. It adds a pill-shaped 'island' at the top of the screen that shows media controls, notifications and shortcuts, similar to the Dynamic Island on recent iPhones. To do that, it needs a few special Android permissions such as notification access.

Island at the top of the screen

Media controls, notifications and shortcuts in a floating capsule, which is the app's own design.

Patches not confirmed

Community build

Made by the AutoBuilds pipeline, not by Vladimir Pryshedko or the Morphe team.

apps.name: Morphe Pandora
apps.description: Pandora with hoo-dles' community morphe-patches: no ads during playback and unlimited skips on stations. It's still the free tier, not Premium.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Pandora?

Pandora is the US radio-style music service. Start a station from a song or artist and it keeps playing similar tracks, getting better as you thumb things up and down. On the free tier you hear ads between songs and you can only skip a limited number of times before it makes you sit through the next track.

This build fixes exactly those two complaints. It was patched by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with hoo-dles/morphe-patches, hoo-dles' bundle (not official Morphe), which has two Pandora patches, both on by default: Disable ads for ads during audio streaming, and Unlimited skips. It doesn't turn your account into Premium, so on-demand play of any song isn't part of it.

What the Pandora patches change

Disable ads

Stops the ads that play during audio streaming on free stations.

Unlimited skips

Skip as many tracks as you want instead of hitting the free-tier limit.

Stations work as usual

Thumbs up and down still shape your stations, just as in the regular app.

No on-demand play

There's no Premium patch in the bundle. Picking any song or album to play stays locked.

  1. Download the APK from the box above. It's one universal file.
  2. Uninstall the Play Store Pandora first. The patched copy is signed with a different key, so Android won't install it over the original.
  3. Give your browser or file manager permission to install apps, then open the APK.
  4. Sign in with your Pandora account. Your stations live on the account, so they'll be there.

Pandora FAQ

It's built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline from hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches, not by the Morphe team, and this unofficial site only links to it. Like any modified APK it carries some risk, so install it only if you trust those sources.

apps.name: Morphe Park4night
apps.description: park4night APK with brosssh's Unlock Pro features patch (park4night+), from the community AutoBuilds pipeline. Requires a logged-in account.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Park4night?

park4night is the app a lot of van and motorhome travellers use to find somewhere to stop for the night. It's a community map of parking spots, aires, campsites and service points, with photos and reviews from people who've stayed there. The paid tier is called park4night+.

The APK on this page was built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with Morphe CLI and the third-party brosssh/morphe-patches bundle, not the official Morphe patches. brosssh's bundle has one park4night patch, Unlock Pro features (park4night+), and it's enabled by default. The catch is that you have to be logged in with a park4night account for it to work.

What the patch changes

park4night+ features

The Unlock Pro features patch enables the park4night+ side of the app without paying for it.

Logged-in account required

The patch description says you need to be logged in. Create a free account if you don't have one.

Same spots and reviews

The places, photos and comments are the community's, loaded from park4night as usual.

Updates come from here

apps.name: Morphe Photomath

What is Morphe Photomath?

Photomath is the camera math solver Google now owns. You point the camera at a printed or handwritten problem and it shows the answer with the working laid out step by step. The free app covers a lot already. Photomath Plus adds the deeper explanations and extra help on top.

This build uses three patches from RookieEnough's community bundle De-Vanced, applied with Morphe CLI by the community AutoBuilds pipeline: Unlock plus, Hide update popup and Spoof device ID. It isn't an official Morphe build and it wasn't made by this site. We only link to it.

Unlock plus

Hide update popup

Scanning works as usual

Photomath FAQ

It's the normal Photomath app with three patches from RookieEnough's open-source De-Vanced bundle, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It isn't from Google or the Morphe developers. apps.name: Morphe Pinterest

What is Morphe Pinterest?

Disable mobile ads

Promoted Pins probably stay

Boards and pins as usual

Saving, boards, search and the feed are the regular Pinterest app.

One universal APK

Pinterest FAQ

It's the Pinterest app with one universal patch from jkennethcarino's open-source adobo bundle, built with Morphe CLI by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. apps.name: Morphe Pixiv

apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Pixiv?

pixiv is the Japanese art community where illustrators and manga artists post their work, and where a lot of people go to browse it. The free app has bottom banner ads and sponsored works in feeds. AI-generated images have also become hard to avoid there.

OLED black theme

How to install

pixiv FAQ

apps.name: Morphe Podcast
apps.description: Podcast Addict patched with the Enable Premium patch from hoo-dles' community morphe-patches. Installs without root; export your podcasts first.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Podcast?

Podcast Addict, patched

What is Morphe Pokecardex?

Pokécardex is a collection manager for the Pokémon Trading Card Game. You point the camera at a card, it recognises it, and the card lands in your collection with its set and number. Free accounts only get a limited number of scans, which runs out fast if you're cataloguing a binder.

This build goes after exactly that limit. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched it with Morphe CLI and Almewty/my-morphe-patches, a small third-party bundle that is still a dev pre-release. It is not an official Morphe patch set, and the Pokécardex developers have nothing to do with it. The bundle has two patches, both switched on by default, and it doesn't touch anything else in the app.

What the two patches change

Scan counter frozen

Disable scan counter stops the app from bumping your scan count each time you scan a card.

Higher free limit

Increase scan limit moves the free allowance from 30 scans to 50, according to the patch description.

Everything else is stock

Collection lists and card details behave like the Play Store app. Nothing beyond the scan limit is unlocked.

32-bit ARM build only

Installing the Pokécardex APK

  1. If Pokécardex from Google Play is on your phone, uninstall it. This APK is signed with a different key, so Android won't update over the store version.
  2. Download the armeabi-v7a APK from the box above. There's no ARM64 or Universal file for this app.
  3. Open the file and let your browser or file manager install unknown apps when Android asks.
  4. Start Pokécardex and sign in again if you use an account.

Phones that dropped 32-bit app support, such as the Pixel 7 and later Pixels, will show a 'not compatible' error. There's nothing to fix on your side; the app just isn't built for them here.

Pokécardex questions

It's an unofficial build. The community AutoBuilds pipeline took the original Pokécardex APK, applied Almewty's open-source my-morphe-patches bundle with Morphe CLI and re-signed it. Neither the Pokécardex developers nor the Morphe team made it. Any modified APK carries some risk, so install it only if you trust the source.
