Only a 32-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a) APK exists for this app. Most ARM64 phones still run 32-bit apps, but some recent ones, like the Pixel 7 and newer, only accept 64-bit apps and will refuse it.

Almewty's patches are written for one specific Pokécardex release. The build pipeline sticks to that release until the bundle supports a newer one.

apps.name: Morphe Prime Video
apps.description: Amazon Prime Video patched with hoo-dles' community morphe-patches: skips ads in the stream and adds speed control. You still need a Prime membership.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Prime Video?

Prime Video is Amazon's streaming app for films and series, including Amazon's own shows. In many countries the standard plan now plays ads, which are stitched into the video stream itself, and the player has no playback speed setting.

This build goes after both. It was patched by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with hoo-dles' morphe-patches, a third-party bundle rather than official Morphe. All three of the bundle's Prime Video patches are on by default: Skip ads jumps over the ads baked into the stream, Enable speed control adds an experimental speed setting to the player, and Rename shared permissions helps it install alongside other Amazon apps. You still need a Prime or Prime Video membership; nothing here gets you content you don't already pay for.

The three Prime Video patches

Skip ads

Automatically skips the ads that are built into the video stream.

Enable speed control

Adds a playback speed control to the player. The patch calls it experimental, so expect rough edges.

Rename shared permissions

Renames some permissions that Amazon apps share, which can fix install errors. It can also break some features.

Membership still required

You sign in with your Amazon account, and what you can watch depends on your subscription.

Installing patched Prime Video

  1. Download the APK from the box above. Only a universal build is published.
  2. Uninstall the Play Store version of Prime Video. Android won't install a differently signed APK over it.
  3. Allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps, then install.
  4. Sign in with your Amazon account. Downloads made in the old app won't carry over, so download them again.

Prime Video FAQ

The community AutoBuilds pipeline, using hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches bundle. It isn't from the Morphe team or from Amazon, and this unofficial site only links to it. You'll be signing in with your Amazon account, so install it only if you trust those sources.

Yes. The patches skip ads and add speed control. They don't give you access to anything your account doesn't already include.

Amazon apps share some permissions, and Android refuses to install an app that defines the same permission with a different signature. The Rename shared permissions patch is there to avoid that clash. Its description warns it can break some features.

apps.name: Morphe Prompter
apps.description: Teleprompter: Vlog & Scripts (Prompter Pal) APK with premium features unlocked by the Teleprompter Premium patch from community paresh-patches.

What is Morphe Prompter?

The app behind this page is Teleprompter: Vlog & Scripts by Solid Labs (the patch bundle lists it as Prompter Pal). It turns your phone into an autocue: your script scrolls next to the camera lens so you can read it while still looking into the camera. You can import scripts from PDF, TXT or Word, set the scroll speed, mirror the text for real teleprompter glass, or float the script over another camera app while you record.

This APK is patched with “Teleprompter Premium” from Paresh Maheshwari’s community paresh-patches bundle, which unlocks the app’s premium features. The patch doesn’t list which ones those are. It isn’t an official Morphe patch; the community AutoBuilds pipeline builds it.

What you get

Premium unlocked

The Teleprompter Premium patch switches on the paid tier inside the app.

Script overlay

The floating script that sits on top of other apps while you record is part of the app.

Mirror mode

Horizontal and vertical mirroring for use with physical teleprompter hardware.

Import your scripts

Load PDF, TXT or Word files instead of retyping them.

Built-in recording

Record straight from the app with the front or back camera, in portrait or landscape.

Which of these the free app limits changes over time, so this list is just what the app does, not a list of what the patch unlocks.

Install steps

  1. If you installed the teleprompter app from the Play Store, uninstall it. This build has a different signature. Copy any scripts you only kept inside the app somewhere else first.
  2. Download the Universal APK above and tap it to install, allowing unknown apps for your browser or file manager.

Teleprompter FAQ

It's Solid Labs' Teleprompter: Vlog & Scripts with Paresh Maheshwari's open-source Teleprompter Premium patch, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It's unofficial, and modified APKs carry some risk. It also asks for camera and microphone access, so install it only if you trust the source.

apps.name: Morphe Proton Mail
apps.description: Proton Mail APK built with Morphe CLI and community patches. Encryption and plan limits still run on Proton's servers. Unofficial build, no root.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Proton Mail?

Proton Mail is the end-to-end encrypted email service from Proton AG in Switzerland. Messages between Proton users are encrypted so that even Proton can't read them, and the app handles the keys for you. The free plan comes with limits on storage and addresses, and paid plans raise them.

The APK on this page was built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with Morphe CLI and a community patch bundle, not the official Morphe patches. We couldn't confirm which bundle: the pipeline switched Proton Mail between two different community sources around the time this file was built, and neither record ties to this exact APK. So we won't list features. One thing is certain. Storage, extra addresses and other paid-plan limits are enforced by Proton's servers, so no patch can raise them.

Before you install

Your Proton account

You sign in with your normal Proton account. Mail, folders and contacts come from Proton's servers.

Patches not identified

The exact community bundle behind this APK couldn't be confirmed, so its changes aren't listed here.

Plan limits are server-side

Storage quota, custom domains and extra addresses are controlled by Proton and stay tied to your plan.

Higher stakes than usual

This app holds access to your encrypted mailbox. A modified build is a bigger trust decision than, say, a game.

Installing Proton Mail

  1. Uninstall the Play Store Proton Mail first. Your mail stays on Proton's servers, but the signature is different, so Android won't install over it.
  2. Download the Universal APK above.
  3. Allow installs from unknown sources for your browser when asked, then install.
  4. Sign in. If you use two-factor authentication, have your code ready.

Proton Mail FAQ

It's unofficial. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched the original Proton Mail APK with Morphe CLI and a community patch bundle, then re-signed it. Proton and the Morphe team didn't make it. For an encrypted email account the risk of a modified app is higher than usual, and the official app is free, so install this only if you fully trust the source.

No. Storage, addresses and other plan limits are enforced by Proton's servers. A patched app can't change them.

Encryption happens in the app with your keys, the same way as in the official build, but you're trusting whoever built this APK not to have changed that. That's why you should only use it if you trust the source.

apps.name: Morphe Proton VPN
apps.description: Proton VPN patched with hoo-dles' community morphe-patches: split tunneling, custom DNS, LAN connections and no server-switch delay. Free servers only.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Proton VPN?

Proton VPN is the VPN from Proton AG, the Swiss company behind Proton Mail. Its free plan has no data cap, which is rare, but you can't choose the server yourself, there's a wait before you can switch to another server, and settings like split tunneling are reserved for the paid Proton Plus plan.

This APK was patched by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with hoo-dles/morphe-patches, hoo-dles' third-party bundle (not official Morphe). The bundle has four Proton VPN patches, all on by default, and they're all about the app's settings: split tunneling, custom DNS, LAN connections, plus removing the delay when you change servers. The paid servers stay paid. Your account decides which servers you can connect to, and no patch changes that.

Four patches for Proton VPN

Unlock split tunneling

Choose which apps go through the VPN and which use your normal connection.

Unlock custom DNS

Point the VPN at your own DNS server instead of Proton's.

Unlock LAN connections

Keep reaching your printer, NAS or Chromecast on the local network while connected.

Remove delay

No more waiting before you can switch to a different server.

Servers don't change

Plus servers and countries still depend on your account, so a free account stays on free servers.

How to install it

  1. Download the APK from the box above. It's a single universal build.
  2. Uninstall the Play Store Proton VPN. The patched copy has a different signature and won't install over it.
  3. Allow installs from unknown sources for your browser or file manager, then install the APK.
  4. Sign in, and accept Android's VPN connection prompt the first time you connect.

Proton VPN FAQ

Think about this one carefully. A VPN app sees all of your traffic. This build comes from the community AutoBuilds pipeline using hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches, not from Proton or the Morphe team, and this unofficial site only links to it. Install it only if you trust those sources.

No. None of the patches touch server access, which your account controls. You get the Plus-only settings on the free servers.

The free app makes you wait before you can switch to another server. This patch takes that wait out.

No. It's a normal APK and uses Android's built-in VPN system.

apps.name: Morphe Pydroid

What is Morphe Pydroid?

Pydroid 3 is a Python 3 IDE that runs entirely on your phone, so you can run scripts with no internet connection. It comes with pip and its own repository of prebuilt packages, which matters for libraries like NumPy, Matplotlib or scikit-learn that are a pain to compile on Android. There's also Tkinter support, a terminal, and a built-in C/C++ compiler for packages with native code. Some features are behind a premium upgrade.

This APK was patched by the community AutoBuilds pipeline using hoo-dles' morphe-patches, a third-party bundle, not the official Morphe one. The bundle has one patch for Pydroid 3, Enable Premium, which turns on the features behind the paywall. The patch description doesn't list which ones those are.

What you get

Enable Premium

The single Pydroid 3 patch in the bundle. It switches the app to its premium state.

Offline Python 3

The interpreter is on the device, so scripts run without a connection.

pip with prebuilt packages

Install scientific libraries from Pydroid's own repository instead of compiling them on your phone.

Made for 64-bit ARM

The app's version name ends in _arm64, which suggests this is the ARM64 build, the kind most phones made in the last several years use.

Installing Pydroid 3

  1. Download the APK from the box above. The file is labelled universal, but the version string points to an ARM64 build, so it suits most modern phones. Older 32-bit or x86 devices may not be able to install it.
  2. If Pydroid 3 is installed from the Play Store, copy your scripts somewhere safe and uninstall it. The patched APK has a different signature.
  3. Allow installs from unknown sources, then install the APK.
  4. Open Pydroid 3 and let it finish its first-run setup before you install packages with pip.

Pydroid 3 FAQ

It's built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline using hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches bundle. The Morphe team didn't make it, and this unofficial site only links to it. An app you write and run code in has access to a lot, so think twice and only install it if you trust those sources.

apps.name: Morphe RAR

What is Morphe RAR?

RAR is the Android version of WinRAR, made by RARLAB. It creates RAR and ZIP archives and opens most of the other formats you're likely to run into, and it doubles as a basic file manager. The free version shows ads unless you pay for the no-ads subscription.

Morphe RAR Features

Ads removed

The Unlock Pro patch strips out the ads you'd normally see in the free version.

No-ads subscription unlocked

The app treats the no-ads subscription as active, so it doesn't keep asking you to buy it.

Archiving untouched

Compression and extraction are RARLAB's own code. The bundle doesn't list any patch that touches them.

Small download

RAR is a light app and this is a single Universal APK, so it's quick to grab even on mobile data.

How to Install Morphe RAR

  1. Uninstall the Play Store version of RAR first. This build is signed with a different key and won't install over it.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above.

Morphe RAR FAQ

It's unofficial. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched the original RAR APK with Morphe CLI and rushiranpise's open-source morphe-patches bundle, then re-signed it. RARLAB and the Morphe team didn't build it. A modified APK always carries some risk, so install it only if you trust the source.

apps.name: Morphe Reddit

What is Morphe Reddit?

This is the app Reddit publishes itself, with the official Morphe patches applied. If you miss the third-party clients that shut down after Reddit's API changes, it's about as close as you can get to a cleaner Reddit while still using the official app. The APK is put together by the community AutoBuilds pipeline; this site just points you to it.

Reddit's patch list is much shorter than YouTube's and sticks to practical things. Promoted posts are gone, the Trending and suggested-community shelves can be hidden, outbound links skip Reddit's redirect and can open in your own browser, and a few nagging dialogs get dismissed for you. It doesn't unlock Reddit Premium or anything tied to your account.

What Morphe changes in Reddit

Promoted posts hidden

The Hide ads patch takes ads out of the feed and comment threads.

Links go straight to the site

Skip Reddit's redirect URLs, open links in your normal browser instead of the in-app one, and strip tracking parameters from links you share.

Fewer shelves in the feed

Hide the Trending shelves in the feed and in search suggestions, the related-communities shelf in subreddits, and the Ask button in the search bar.

Start as guest

Skips the login screen that Reddit forces on startup by using its own guest browsing mode, so you can read without an account.

Fewer popups

No popup every time you take a screenshot. The NSFW community warning and the notification suggestion dialog are dismissed automatically.

Your font, not Reddit Sans

Render the app in your phone's system font, or load any TTF or OTF file you have.

View counts on posts

Shows how many times a post has been viewed, a number the stock app keeps hidden.

Trimmed navigation

Hide buttons in the bottom navigation bar and items in the sidebar, and pick from the alternative Reddit app icons.

How to install Morphe Reddit

  1. Uninstall the Play Store Reddit first. This build keeps Reddit's normal package name but has a different signature, so Android won't put it on top of the original. Your subscriptions and saved posts are stored on Reddit's servers, so all you lose is the login.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above.
  3. Open it, allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps if asked, and tap Install.

Morphe Reddit FAQ

It's Reddit's own APK with the open-source MorpheApp/morphe-patches bundle applied, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline rather than this site or the Morphe developers. The patches are public, but modified APKs always carry some risk. Install it only if you trust the source.

apps.name: Morphe Smart Launcher

What is Morphe Smart Launcher?

Smart Launcher replaces your phone's home screen. Its party trick is the app drawer: it sorts everything you install into categories on its own, so you rarely scroll through one long alphabetical list. You also get its own widgets, gesture shortcuts and a theme that picks up colours from your wallpaper. Some of the customisation options are reserved for the Pro upgrade.

What this Smart Launcher build changes

Enable Pro

Same launcher underneath

The auto-sorted drawer, home pages, widgets and gestures are Smart Launcher's own. The patch doesn't add or remove screens.

One APK for every phone

Community maintained

Smart Launcher questions

What you get in this build

Enable Premium

Overnight recording as normal

Recording, snore detection and the morning report work the way they do in the Play Store app. Nothing about the measuring is changed.

Remedies and factors

Universal APK

SnoreLab FAQ

Sofascore without the ads

Disable ads

Same coverage

No premium unlock

apps.description: Solid Explorer APK with hoo-dles' community Enable Pro patch. The two-pane file manager with cloud and network access. Universal APK, no root.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Solid Explorer?

Solid Explorer by NeatBytes is a file manager with two panes side by side, which makes moving files between folders a lot less fiddly than on most Android file apps. It opens ZIP and other archives, and it can connect to FTP, SFTP and SMB shares as well as cloud storage. After the trial period runs out, the app wants you to buy the full version.

Here you get Solid Explorer with the Enable Pro patch from hoo-dles/morphe-patches, a community bundle maintained by hoo-dles. It targets the paywall that normally appears once the trial is over. The community AutoBuilds pipeline produces the APK with the Morphe CLI, so it isn't an official Morphe build, and NeatBytes didn't make it either.

What's different in this build

Enable Pro

The bundle's only Solid Explorer patch. It removes the purchase lock the app puts on its features.

Two panes, unchanged

Dual-pane browsing, archives and the file operations themselves are exactly what NeatBytes ships.

Network and cloud

Remote connections are set up the same way as in the official app. If you switch over, you'll need to add them again.

Universal APK

There's a single APK for all architectures, so just download it.

Installing Solid Explorer

  1. Write down your FTP, SMB or cloud logins if you rely on them. Uninstalling the Play Store copy removes saved connections.
  2. Uninstall the Play Store version. This APK is signed differently, so it can't replace it in place.
  3. Download the APK above and allow installs from unknown sources for the app you downloaded it with.
  4. Open Solid Explorer and give it the all-files access it asks for, or it can only see a few folders.

Solid Explorer FAQ

It's built from hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches bundle by the community AutoBuilds pipeline, not by NeatBytes or the Morphe developers. A file manager has access to everything on your storage, so only install it if you trust that source.

No. You have to remove the Play Store version first, and that clears its saved servers and cloud accounts. Add them again in the new install.

No. It installs like any other app. Root is only relevant if you want Solid Explorer to browse system folders, and that's the same as in the official version.

apps.name: Morphe SoundCloud
apps.description: SoundCloud APK with hoo-dles' Enable SoundCloud Go and Disable telemetry patches. Community build, universal APK, no root needed.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe SoundCloud?

SoundCloud is where a lot of music turns up before it reaches anywhere else: DJ mixes, remixes, bedroom producers, unofficial edits, plus podcasts and big-label releases. The free tier plays ads between tracks and holds a few things back for the paid SoundCloud Go plans.

This build applies two patches from hoo-dles' community bundle hoo-dles/morphe-patches. Enable SoundCloud Go targets the features locked behind the subscription, and Disable telemetry turns off SoundCloud's telemetry system. The APK is built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with the Morphe CLI. That makes it unofficial: not a Morphe release, and not something SoundCloud supports.

Patches in this SoundCloud build

Enable SoundCloud Go

Switches on the Go features the app gates on your phone. What SoundCloud checks on its own servers is a different matter.

Disable telemetry

Stops the app's built-in telemetry from reporting what you do.

AMOLED theme not included

The bundle has a true-black dark theme patch for SoundCloud, but it's off by default, so the automated build most likely leaves it out.

Universal APK

One download for every phone, no architecture to pick.

How to install SoundCloud from here

  1. Uninstall the official SoundCloud app if you have it. Downloads you saved for offline listening go with it.
  2. Download the APK from the box above.
  3. Let your browser or file manager install unknown apps, then install the file.
  4. Open the app and sign in with your usual SoundCloud account. Your likes and playlists are stored online, so they come back.

SoundCloud build: common questions

It's SoundCloud with two patches from hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches bundle, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It's unofficial and modified, so there's always some risk, including to the account you sign in with. Install it only if you trust that source.

No. The patch changes how the app checks your plan on the phone; your account doesn't get upgraded. Anything SoundCloud enforces on its servers can still be limited.

Not in this build, as far as we can tell. The patch exists in hoo-dles' bundle but isn't enabled by default. You'd have to patch SoundCloud yourself with a patcher that accepts custom bundles and tick that patch.

No. Both use the same package name. Uninstall the official one first.

apps.name: Morphe Splitwise
apps.description: Splitwise APK patched with ReVanced CLI and burgers1312's Enable Features patch, which forces some in-app feature checks on. Community build.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Splitwise?

Splitwise is the app people use to split rent, trips and dinners. Everyone logs what they paid, Splitwise works out who owes whom, and the balances sync across the group. Some extras are reserved for the paid Splitwise Pro plan.

This APK wasn't made with Morphe at all. The community AutoBuilds pipeline built it with ReVanced CLI and burgers1312/revanced-patches, a one-person bundle that has a single Splitwise patch called Enable Features. Its own description just says it 'enables features by skipping checks'. In the source, it makes two checks in a class named AdFeatureStatus (whether a feature is enabled and whether it's visible) always answer yes. The bundle doesn't list which screens that affects, so don't expect a full Pro unlock.

What the build actually does

Enable Features patch

Forces Splitwise's feature-status checks for 'enabled' and 'visible' to return true inside the app.

Effect isn't documented

burgers1312 doesn't say which features this exposes. Treat anything extra you see as a bonus, not a promise.

Server checks stay

Anything Splitwise verifies on its servers still needs a real Pro subscription. A patch can only change what the app decides locally.

Groups sync as usual

Expenses, groups and balances are still stored in your Splitwise account. The patch doesn't touch syncing.

How to install it

  1. Remove the Play Store Splitwise first. Your data lives in your account, so nothing is lost, but the signatures differ and Android won't install one over the other.
  2. Download the Universal APK above. It's the only file and works on any phone.
  3. Allow installs from unknown sources for your browser when asked, then tap Install.
  4. Open Splitwise and log in with your usual account.

Splitwise FAQ

It's unofficial. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched the original Splitwise APK with ReVanced CLI and burgers1312's open-source revanced-patches bundle, then re-signed it. Splitwise didn't make it, and neither did the Morphe team. Modified APKs carry risk, especially for an app that knows your contacts and payments, so only install it if you trust the source.

That isn't documented. The patch is called Enable Features and makes two feature-status checks always return true. Anything Splitwise checks on its own servers still needs a paid subscription.

Yes. Everything is stored in your Splitwise account. Log in and your groups, friends and history load like they do in the official app.

No. This one was built with ReVanced CLI and a ReVanced-format patch bundle by burgers1312. It's listed on this site with the other community builds.

apps.name: Morphe Starsense
apps.description: Celestron StarSense Explorer APK patched to skip the unlock code check, using the StarSense Unlock patch from community paresh-patches.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe StarSense Explorer?

StarSense Explorer is Celestron’s companion app for its StarSense Explorer telescopes. You clip your phone into the dock on the telescope, the app looks at the stars through the phone camera, works out where the scope is pointing, and then shows arrows to guide you to planets, nebulae or galaxies that are up tonight. It also has a planetarium view. Normally the app stays locked until you enter the code that comes with the telescope.

This build uses “StarSense Unlock” from Paresh Maheshwari’s community paresh-patches bundle. The patch bypasses the unlock-code check so all features are enabled. It’s a community patch, not an official Morphe one, and the APK comes from the community AutoBuilds pipeline.

What the patch does and doesn’t do

No unlock code needed

The code prompt is skipped and the app opens with every feature enabled.

Planetarium and object list

Browse what’s visible from your location tonight, same as in the official app.

Sky recognition with the dock

The live pointing guidance still needs a StarSense Explorer telescope with the phone dock. The patch doesn’t change that.

Universal APK

A single file for any ARM phone.

Installing StarSense Explorer

  1. Uninstall the Play Store StarSense Explorer if it’s installed. The patched build is signed with a different key.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above and open it. Allow installs from your browser or file manager when asked.
  3. Open the app and allow camera and location access. Location is how it knows which part of the sky is above you.
  4. If you use it with the telescope, go through Celestron’s normal dock alignment before your first session.

StarSense Explorer FAQ

It's Celestron's app with Paresh Maheshwari's open-source StarSense Unlock patch, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It's unofficial and Celestron doesn't support it. Modified APKs carry some risk, so only install it if you trust the source.

For the sky recognition and the arrows that guide the telescope, yes. That relies on the phone sitting in the StarSense dock. The patch only removes the unlock-code check.

Mostly if you've lost the unlock code. If you still have it, the official app works fine and gets Celestron's updates.

Download newer builds from this page and install them over the old one. The Play Store won't update it.

apps.name: Morphe Strava
apps.description: Strava APK with rushiranpise's Unlock Premium patch, which also brings back password login. Built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. No root.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Strava?

Strava records your runs, rides, swims and hikes with GPS, then puts them on a feed for your friends to see. It's also where segments and leaderboards live. A lot of the analysis, route and training tools sit behind the paid subscription.

The APK on this page was built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with Morphe CLI and the third-party rushiranpise/morphe-patches bundle, not the official Morphe patches. The bundle has one Strava patch, Unlock Premium, on by default. According to its description it unlocks Strava's Premium features and also re-enables password login after the one-time-code (OTP) step. Keep in mind that anything Strava works out on its own servers may still depend on a real subscription.

Patched in this Strava build

Unlock Premium

Turns on Strava's subscriber features inside the app, from rushiranpise's only Strava patch.

Password login is back

The same patch re-enables password login after OTP, which helps if the emailed code is a hassle.

Server-side limits

Features that Strava computes or serves from its own servers may stay locked. The patch can only change what the app decides itself.

Recording works as normal

GPS tracking, uploads and the feed are Strava's own. Your activities go to your account like always.

How to Install Morphe Strava

  1. Uninstall Strava from the Play Store. The patched APK has a different signature, so Android won't install it on top. Make sure any recorded activity has finished uploading first.
  2. Download the Universal APK above. It's the only build, so it runs on any phone.
  3. Allow your browser to install unknown apps when prompted (Settings → Apps → Special app access → Install unknown apps).
  4. Install, open Strava and sign in. You can use your password again.

Morphe Strava FAQ

It's an unofficial build. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched the original Strava APK with Morphe CLI and rushiranpise's open-source morphe-patches bundle and re-signed it. Strava and the Morphe team didn't make it. Modified APKs carry risk, and this one has access to your Strava account and location, so install it only if you trust the source.

Yes, that's part of the patch. Its description says it re-enables password login after OTP.

Not necessarily. The patch unlocks Premium in the app, but anything Strava calculates or serves from its servers may still need a real subscription.

Yes. Recording and uploading are unchanged, so your activities end up on your Strava account and your friends see them as usual.

apps.name: Morphe Tasker
apps.description: Tasker APK with the Unlock trial patch from indrastorms' Dropped-Patches, so the trial-expired dialog no longer locks you out. ReVanced CLI build.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Tasker?

Tasker is João Dias's automation app. You build profiles from triggers like time, location, Wi-Fi or an incoming notification, and Tasker runs tasks in response: toggling settings, sending messages, launching apps, calling plugins. It's sold on Google Play, and the trial version stops working with a dialog you can't dismiss once the trial period is over.

This build removes that wall. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched it with ReVanced CLI and indrastorms/Dropped-Patches, a bundle that picked up patches other projects had dropped. It's not part of Morphe. Its Tasker patch, Unlock trial, makes the license check method return before it does anything, so the trial-over dialog never appears. Everything else is the normal Tasker.

What changes in this Tasker build

Trial doesn't run out

Unlock trial skips the license check that would otherwise show the trial-expired dialog.

Full Tasker otherwise

Profiles, tasks, scenes and variables are untouched. It's the same automation engine.

Plugins are separate

AutoApps and other plugins have their own licences, and this patch doesn't cover them.

Built with ReVanced CLI

A community ReVanced-format patch applied by the AutoBuilds pipeline, not a Morphe build.

Installing Tasker

  1. Export a backup of your profiles and tasks from your current Tasker first, then uninstall it. The signatures don't match, so Android won't install this APK over the Play Store version.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above.
  3. Allow your browser to install unknown apps and install the file.
  4. Open Tasker, import your backup and grant the permissions your profiles need again.

Some Tasker actions need extra permissions granted over ADB. If you set those up before, you'll have to grant them again for the reinstalled app.

Tasker FAQ

It's unofficial. The community AutoBuilds pipeline patched the original Tasker APK with ReVanced CLI and indrastorms' open-source Dropped-Patches bundle and re-signed it. João Dias and the Morphe team didn't make it. Tasker can be given very broad permissions, so modified builds carry real risk. Install it only if you trust the source.

Not automatically, because you have to uninstall the Play Store version first. Back up your data in Tasker before uninstalling, then import it into the new install.

No. The only patch skips Tasker's own trial license check. Plugins are separate apps with their own licensing.

Tasker comes from a small independent developer and is a one-time purchase on Google Play. If you use it every day, buying it supports updates and gets you a build that updates from the Play Store.

apps.name: Morphe Telegram
apps.description: Telegram APK built with Paresh Maheshwari's community paresh-patches: anti-delete, no sponsored messages and more where the patches apply. Unofficial.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Telegram?

Telegram needs little introduction: a cloud-based messenger with chats, big groups, channels and file sharing, where your message history lives on Telegram’s servers and syncs across every device you log in on.

The APK linked here comes from the community AutoBuilds pipeline, which runs Paresh Maheshwari’s paresh-patches bundle through Morphe CLI. These are community patches, not official Morphe ones, and not from Telegram. One caveat we found: the bundle declares its Telegram patches for the direct-download edition from telegram.org, while this APK uses the regular Play Store package name. We couldn’t confirm that every patch listed below is active in this build, so check the behaviour you care about after installing.

What the Telegram patch set does

Anti-delete

Messages someone deletes stay visible on your phone, and view-once or self-destructing media can be opened again.

No sponsored messages

Removes the sponsored messages in channels and video ads.

Hidden typing indicator

Other people don’t see “typing…” while you write.

Fewer channel restrictions

Opens channels that are blocked or flagged as sensitive and lets you save from channels that disable saving.

Faster downloads

Uses bigger download chunks and more parallel requests for large files.

Premium features

The patch set includes a Telegram Premium patch. Anything Telegram enforces on its servers, like larger upload limits, can’t be unlocked from the app side.

How to install

  1. Uninstall the Play Store Telegram first. This build uses the same package name with a different signature, so Android won’t install it on top.
  2. Before uninstalling, keep in mind that secret chats only exist on the device and are lost. Normal cloud chats come back after you log in.
  3. Download the Universal APK from the box above and open it, allowing installs from your browser or file manager.
  4. Log in with your phone number and the code Telegram sends you, then re-enable notifications in Android settings if needed.

Telegram FAQ

It's Telegram rebuilt by the community AutoBuilds pipeline with Paresh Maheshwari's open-source paresh-patches bundle. It's unofficial and not from Telegram. A messenger has access to all your conversations, so be careful with modified versions and install it only if you trust the source.

We can't promise that. The bundle targets Telegram's telegram.org edition, and this APK uses the Play Store package name. Check the features you want, such as anti-delete, after installing.

Cloud chats, groups and channels sync back as soon as you log in. Secret chats are stored only on the old install and won't come back.

Only in the app, if at all. Things Telegram checks on its servers, such as the bigger upload limit, still need a real subscription.

Download the newer APK from this page and install it over the old one. The Play Store won't update it.

apps.name: Morphe Teuida
apps.description: Teuida APK from the community AutoBuilds pipeline. hoo-dles has paused its Teuida patches, so this build has no confirmed changes yet.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Teuida?

Teuida is a language app built around speaking, best known for its Korean course. Instead of tapping through flashcards, you're dropped into staged situations, like ordering in a café or meeting someone new, and you answer the person on screen out loud.

The honest part: the AutoBuilds manifest says this APK is built with hoo-dles' community bundle hoo-dles/morphe-patches, but that bundle currently has no Teuida patches. The maintainer removed them in July 2026 while waiting for a MicroG RE update, and they haven't come back in the release used for this build. So we can't point to anything this APK changes compared with the Play Store app. It isn't an official Morphe or Teuida release either.

Where this Teuida build stands

Teuida patches on hold

hoo-dles pulled them temporarily. Until they're back in the bundle, no Teuida-specific change is applied.

The normal Teuida app

Lessons and speaking practice behave like the official app, because that's essentially what this is right now.

May change later

If the patches return to the bundle, later builds should pick them up. Check the bundle's patch list to see.

Universal APK

One build that runs on any architecture.

If you still want to install it

  1. Uninstall the Play Store version first if you have it. The signature is different, so the two clash.
  2. Download the APK above and allow installs from your browser or file manager.
  3. Install it and sign in. Your course progress is tied to your Teuida account, not to this APK.

Teuida FAQ

It comes from the community AutoBuilds pipeline, which lists hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches bundle as its source. It's unofficial and re-signed, so treat it with the usual caution for modified APKs and only install it if you trust that source.

Not that we can confirm. hoo-dles temporarily removed the Teuida patches from the bundle, so this build has no known premium patch.

Right now there's little reason to. The Play Store version is the safer choice until the Teuida patches are back.

apps.name: Morphe Threads
apps.description: Threads APK with durgesh0505's community Morphe patches: sponsored posts hidden, ad ID permission removed, installs beside the official app.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Threads?

Threads is Meta's text-first social app, linked to your Instagram account. The patch set here is small. durgesh0505/chiggi_morphe_patches is a community bundle that covers a mix of apps and has four patches for Threads, and this build uses all of them. It's not an official Morphe bundle, and the APK is built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline.

It's mostly about ads. Sponsored posts and the suggested units Meta mixes into the feed are hidden, and the advertising ID permission is removed so the app can't read your device's ad ID. The author is clear that the ad blocking happens in the app only and that Meta's core analytics keep running. The other two patches rename the package and the app label so it can sit next to the regular Threads.

The four Threads patches

Sponsored posts hidden

Sponsored posts and injected suggested units are dropped from the feed. It's done on your phone, so Meta still serves the ads; you just don't see them.

No advertising ID

Removes the AD_ID permission so Threads can't read your device's advertising ID for ad tracking. Other analytics are unaffected.

Runs beside the official app

A different package name means you can keep the Play Store Threads installed and use both.

Its own name on the home screen

The app label is changed so you can tell the patched copy from the original in your launcher.

Installing Morphe Threads

  1. Download the Universal APK from the box above.
  2. Install it, allowing unknown apps for your browser or file manager when asked. There's no need to remove the official Threads, since this one has its own package name.
  3. Log in. If one-tap login through Instagram or Facebook doesn't work, use your username and password instead.

The package rename has known side effects. The patch author warns that Meta apps hardcode a lot of internal references, so single sign-on, content sharing between Meta apps or push notifications may not work properly.

Morphe Threads questions

It's the Threads APK with durgesh0505's open-source chiggi_morphe_patches bundle applied, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline and not by this site or the Morphe developers. There's always some risk with a modified app, so only install it if you trust the source.

The build renames the package so it can live next to the official app. Meta's apps expect the original name, and the patch author warns this can break Facebook and Instagram single sign-on, content providers and push notifications. Logging in with your password usually gets around it.

Not really. It removes the advertising ID permission and hides ads in the feed, but Meta's own analytics still run.

No. Because of the different package name you can keep both.

Threads doesn't get much attention from patch developers yet. This bundle has four Threads patches and the build includes all four. There's no download, theming or feed filtering patch for Threads in it.

apps.name: Morphe Ticktick
apps.description: TickTick APK with Premium, AI tools and working reminders, built from three patches in Paresh Maheshwari's community paresh-patches bundle.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe TickTick?

TickTick from TickTick Limited is a to-do list and calendar in one app, with habits and a Pomodoro timer thrown in, and it syncs your tasks across phone, web and desktop. The free plan works but sets limits on things like lists and tasks, and saves things like the full calendar views and the AI tools for Premium.

This build combines three patches from Paresh Maheshwari’s community paresh-patches bundle. “TickTick Premium” unlocks the premium features, removes the limits and enables the AI tools. The other two exist because re-signing an APK normally breaks things: one fixes push notifications, the other brings back reminder alarms. These aren’t official Morphe patches; the community AutoBuilds pipeline applies them.

What’s patched

Premium in the app

Premium features and the free-plan limits are lifted on this phone.

AI tools

The patch enables TickTick’s AI tools. They run on TickTick’s servers, so they may still refuse to work for a free account.

Notifications that arrive

The Restore notifications patch spoofs the original signing certificate so Firebase push messages still reach the app.

Reminder alarms

Restore reminder alarms fixes alarm scheduling, which otherwise breaks on a re-signed TickTick.

Switching to this build

  1. Make sure your tasks are synced to your TickTick account, then uninstall the Play Store version. The signatures don’t match.
  2. Download the Universal APK above and open it. Allow installs from your browser or file manager if Android asks.
  3. Sign in. If you use Google sign-in and it fails, try email and password instead. We haven’t verified Google sign-in on this build.
  4. Allow notifications and, on newer Android versions, the alarms and reminders permission, then set a test reminder a few minutes out.

TickTick FAQ

It's TickTick with three patches from Paresh Maheshwari's open-source paresh-patches bundle, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It's unofficial and not from TickTick Limited. You sign in with your real account, so install it only if you trust the source.

That's what two of the three patches are for. Restore notifications keeps push messages working after re-signing and Restore reminder alarms fixes alarm scheduling. Set a test reminder after installing to be sure.

No. The patch changes this Android app only. Your account stays on the free plan on TickTick's servers, so other devices and anything checked server-side are unchanged.

Download newer builds from this page and install them over the current one. The Play Store won't update it.

apps.name: Morphe TikTok
apps.description: TikTok APK with icysymmetra's community Morphe patches: watermark-free downloads, a feed filter for ads and Shop, playback speed and region spoof.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe TikTok?

TikTok is ByteDance's short-video app. This build is the global TikTok with icysymmetra/tiktok-patches-for-morphe applied; inside the app the patches show up as a Metra patches settings menu. It's a community bundle, not part of the official Morphe patches, and the APK comes out of the community AutoBuilds pipeline.

Downloads are the main reason to use it: no watermark, a choice of quality, your own folder and filename format. Close behind is the feed filter, which can hide ads, TikTok Shop items, lives, stories and photo posts, or anything outside a view or like range you set. Be ready for a big download, since it's one Universal APK that carries the native code for every phone type.

What's patched in Morphe TikTok

Watermark-free downloads

Save videos without the TikTok watermark, pick the quality, choose the folder and filename template, and save comment stickers.

Feed filter

Hide ads, Shop items, lives, stories and photo posts, plus videos outside a view or like range. There's also a filter for some of the unpersonalized filler on For You and for posts labelled as AI-made.

Playback controls

Playback speed for every video, remembered between videos. Show the seekbar with preview thumbnails, stop videos from looping, and lock 2x with a hold-and-slide.

Region spoof

In-app controls to change the region TikTok reads from your device.

Login fixes

Google sign-in works again after patching, and the mandatory login gate is removed from the flows that support it.

Better comments

Full comment sorting, built-in comment translation, copy a comment without the username, and the publish date always shown on videos.

Less clutter

Hide the LIVE, follow, save and search buttons on the feed, the floating coin and promo badges, suggested accounts and the Tako AI bubble.

Screenshots allowed

Screenshot blocking and capture detection are turned off, Circle to Search included. Links open in your browser and shared links lose their tracking.

How to install Morphe TikTok

  1. If you have TikTok from the Play Store, uninstall it first. This build doesn't rename the package, so Android won't install it over a differently signed copy.
  2. Download the Universal APK from the box above. It's a very large file, so use Wi-Fi and make sure you have the space.
  3. Allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps, then install the APK.
  4. Sign in (Google login is fixed by one of the patches) and open the Metra patches settings to set up downloads and filters.

Common questions about Morphe TikTok

It's the TikTok APK with icysymmetra's open-source community patches applied, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline, not by this site and not by the Morphe developers. Modified apps carry some risk and TikTok doesn't permit them, so only install it if you trust the source.

It should. Re-signing normally breaks Google login in TikTok, and the bundle's Fix Google login patch is included to restore it.

It changes the region TikTok reads from your device, which can affect what content and features you get. It doesn't change your IP address and won't get around blocks at the network level.

There's only a Universal build, which bundles native libraries for every processor type instead of just the one your phone uses. TikTok is a big app to begin with.

Come back to this page and install the newer APK over the old one. If Android refuses because the signature changed, uninstall first; your account comes back after you sign in, but local drafts are lost.

apps.name: Morphe Trakt
apps.description: Trakt APK with PixelPusher247's community patch that removes the Upgrade to VIP banner from the home screen. VIP features stay locked. No root.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe Trakt?

Trakt keeps track of the shows and films you watch. It scrobbles from media players, keeps your history and watchlist in one place, and suggests what to watch next. The free app works fine but keeps reminding you about Trakt VIP.

This build only deals with that reminder. It was patched by the community AutoBuilds pipeline using Morphe CLI and PixelPusher247/morphe-patches, a third-party bundle and not the official Morphe patches. The bundle has one patch, Hide VIP banner, which takes the Upgrade to VIP upsell off the home screen. That is the whole change. VIP-only features aren't unlocked, and the rest of the app is the normal Trakt client.

Inside this Trakt build

No VIP banner

The Upgrade to VIP card no longer sits on top of your home screen.

Stock Trakt otherwise

History, watchlist, check-ins and recommendations work exactly as in the Play Store version.

VIP stays VIP

Paid features aren't touched. If you want them, you still need a real VIP subscription.

Your account, unchanged

You sign in with your normal Trakt account, and everything syncs to it.

Getting it on your phone

  1. Uninstall the official Trakt app if you have it. Your history is on Trakt's servers, so you won't lose it.
  2. Grab the Universal APK from the download box. It's the only build and fits any device.
  3. Open it and allow your browser to install apps when Android prompts you.
  4. Launch Trakt and sign in.

Trakt questions

Truecaller is the caller ID and spam blocker from Truecaller AB. It looks up unknown numbers as they ring, warns you about spam and scam calls, and can take over as your phone and SMS app. Over the years it has piled on tabs for Premium, an AI call Assistant, Scams and Family Protection.

The floating button, internal audio support and facecam are XRecorder's own features and aren't modified.

Your videos stay yours

Recordings are saved to your phone's storage like in the official app.

Universal APK

There's only a universal build, so it's one download for any phone.

Installing XRecorder

  1. Uninstall the Play Store XRecorder if you have it. This APK has a different signature.
  2. Download the APK from the box above and allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps.
  3. Install it, then allow the overlay permission so the floating button can appear.
  4. Start your first recording and accept Android's screen-capture prompt.

XRecorder FAQ

It's built from hoo-dles' open-source morphe-patches bundle by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. It's unofficial and modified, and a screen recorder can see whatever is on your screen, so install it only if you trust that source.

The bundle gives no description for it, only the name. It's aimed at XRecorder's Pro upgrade, but we can't confirm which features it covers.

Videos saved to your phone's shared storage normally stay after you uninstall. The app's settings are reset.

Android lets each app block internal audio capture, and older Android versions don't support it at all. That's an Android limit, not something the patch changes.

apps.description: Morphe YouTube APK with the official Morphe patches: ads hidden, background play, SponsorBlock and Return YouTube Dislike. Sign-in needs MicroG RE.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe YouTube?

Most of what bugs people about YouTube on Android is the same short list: an ad before nearly every video, Premium banners, a Shorts shelf in the middle of the home feed, and audio that cuts out the moment you switch apps. This is the regular YouTube app with the official Morphe patches (MorpheApp/morphe-patches) already applied, so you get those fixes without running Morphe Manager yourself.

The APK is built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. Neither the Morphe developers nor this site build it; we link to the file and refresh that link several times a day. The build uses Morphe's default patch selection for YouTube, which is nearly the whole list. Almost every patch adds a switch instead of forcing a change, so the first thing to do after installing is open YouTube's settings, find the Morphe section and go through it.

What the Morphe patches add to YouTube

Ads and Premium nags hidden

The Hide ads patch covers video ads, feed ads and Premium promotions. If there's a creator you want to support, Channel whitelist lets ads back in on that channel only.

Background playback

Audio keeps going with the screen off or when you leave the app, kids videos included. A picture-in-picture button can also be added to the player.

SponsorBlock built in

Skips sponsor reads and other segments marked by the SponsorBlock community. You decide which kinds get skipped automatically and which just show up on the seekbar.

Dislikes and honest titles

Return YouTube Dislike shows an estimated dislike count again. DeArrow can replace clickbait titles and thumbnails, and Restore original titles stops YouTube from auto-translating them.

Shorts on your terms

Hide the Shorts shelf in feeds, drop the Shorts button from the bottom bar, or open Shorts in the normal player where you can seek and change speed.

Player defaults that stick

Set a default video quality and playback speed, add swipe controls for volume and brightness, put a loop button in the player, and get rid of the Continue watching? pause.

Downloads through another app

The download button can hand a video to an external downloader you have installed. The patch doesn't save files itself, so you'll need such an app.

A tidier watch page

Hide end screen cards, info cards, related videos or single buttons under the player. Shared links also lose their tracking parameters.

Installing Morphe YouTube

  1. Install MicroG RE first. This build includes Morphe's GmsCore support patch, which means the app talks to microG instead of Google Play Services. Without it you can't sign in to your Google account. This MicroG RE guide covers which file to pick and what to do if sign-in fails.
  2. Download the APK from the box above. There's a single Universal file, so there's nothing to pick.
  3. Open it and let your browser or file manager install unknown apps when Android asks, then tap Install.
  4. Open the app, sign in through MicroG, then find the Morphe section in YouTube's settings and choose what you want turned on.

The GmsCore patch also gives the app its own package name, so it installs next to the stock YouTube instead of replacing it. If Android still refuses, you most likely have an older patched YouTube signed with a different key; uninstall that one and try again. Many people disable the stock YouTube app afterwards so links open in the patched one.

Morphe YouTube FAQ

It's the normal YouTube APK with the open-source MorpheApp/morphe-patches bundle applied, built by the community AutoBuilds pipeline rather than by this site or the Morphe developers. Every patch is public on GitHub, but any modified APK carries some risk, so only install it if you trust where it comes from.

Because the app is re-signed and renamed, it can't use Google Play Services for your account. The GmsCore support patch points it at microG instead, and MicroG RE is the build Morphe maintains. Install it even if you plan to watch logged out, since the patched app expects it to be there.

No. Ads are hidden and background play works on your phone, but your Google account doesn't get a Premium subscription. Anything YouTube checks on its own servers stays exactly as it is.

YouTube changes its playback checks every so often. The build includes the Spoof video streams patch, and changing its client option in the Morphe settings is the usual first fix. If nothing helps, wait for a newer build to show up here.

Not through the Play Store, which sees it as a different app. Download the newer APK here and install it over the old one. If Android refuses because the signature changed, uninstall the old copy first; you'll have to sign in again.

apps.description: Morphe YouTube Music APK with the official Morphe patches: no ads, screen-off playback, synced lyrics and Last.fm scrobbling. ARM64 and ARMv7 builds.
apps.description_html:
What is Morphe YouTube Music?

YouTube Music is Google's app for songs, albums and podcasts. On a free account it plays ads between tracks and stops as soon as the screen goes off, and fixing those two things is most of what this build is for. It's the stock app with the official Morphe patches applied by the community AutoBuilds pipeline. This site only links to the APK.

Beyond the basics there are some nice extras: a proper crossfade between tracks, synced lyrics pulled from third-party providers, scrobbling to Last.fm or ListenBrainz, and an option to play the song version of an album track rather than its music video. Nearly all of it lives behind switches in the Morphe settings, so you can leave alone whatever you don't care about.

What's different in Morphe YouTube Music

No ads between songs

Fullscreen ads, video ads and the Premium promotions are hidden by the Hide ads patch.

Keeps playing with the screen off

Background playback restrictions are removed, and audio-only mode lets you play a track without loading its video.

Synced lyrics

The Third-party lyrics patch fills the lyrics panel with time-synced lyrics from outside providers, which helps a lot for tracks where YouTube has none.

Scrobbling

Send what you play to Last.fm or ListenBrainz straight from the app, no separate scrobbler needed.

Crossfade and saner queues

A dual-player crossfade between tracks, shuffle and repeat that stay how you left them, and an option to play just the tapped song instead of replacing your queue with the whole album.

Android Auto

Patched apps normally lose their playlists and podcasts in Android Auto. The Android Auto patch bypasses that certificate check.

Speed, pitch and SponsorBlock

Change playback speed and pitch, skip silent gaps in podcasts, and let SponsorBlock jump over non-music parts of music videos.

Downloads

The in-app download button is wired up to save songs, either through an external downloader app or inside YouTube Music itself.

How to install it

  1. Install MicroG RE. The build includes the GmsCore support patch, so your Google sign-in goes through microG. If you haven't set it up before, follow the MicroG RE sign-in guide.
  2. Pick the right APK. There's no Universal file for YouTube Music, only ARM64 and ARMv7. Almost every phone sold in recent years needs ARM64. Choose ARMv7 only for an older or low-end device running 32-bit Android. x86 devices and most PC emulators aren't covered by either file.
  3. Allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps, then open the APK and install it. Its package name differs from the stock app, so the two can sit side by side.
  4. Sign in through MicroG, then open YouTube Music's settings and look for the Morphe section.

Questions about Morphe YouTube Music

It's built from Google's own YouTube Music APK and the open-source MorpheApp/morphe-patches bundle by the community AutoBuilds pipeline, not by this site. You can check the patches yourself on GitHub. A modified APK still carries risk, so install it only if you're comfortable with the source.

ARM64 for pretty much any current phone. ARMv7 is for older or budget devices running a 32-bit version of Android. If the ARM64 file refuses to install with a message about the package being incompatible, try ARMv7.

Yes, if you want to sign in. The GmsCore support patch replaces Google Play Services with microG for your account, and MicroG RE is the version Morphe maintains.

The build includes Morphe's Android Auto patch, which restores playlists and podcasts that Android Auto would otherwise hide for a re-signed app. Android Auto may also need Unknown sources enabled in its developer settings before it lists apps that didn't come from the Play Store.

No subscription is added to your account. Ads are hidden and screen-off playback works on the device, but anything Google decides on its servers stays the same.
